intro.en: The thermal limit of a finished lead depends on its actual route, load and lowest-rated component.
intro.zh: 成品引线的耐热边界取决于真实路径、负载及额定值最低的部件。

knowledge.en: Silicone, FEP, PTFE and glass-braid constructions require exact product data; a material name alone is not a rating.
knowledge.zh: 硅橡胶、FEP、PTFE 与玻纤编织结构都要核对准确型号数据，材料名称不能单独代表额定值。

notes.en: Provide the thermal map, current, route, connector drawings, material data and acceptance criteria.
notes.zh: 请提供温度分布、电流、路径、接头图纸、材料数据及验收标准。

delivery.en: Release the complete assembly against approved drawings and project-specific thermal and electrical checks.
delivery.zh: 按获批图纸及项目特定的热工、电气检查放行完整组件。

intro.en: Flexible leads must be specified against their installed motion, not selected by hand feel alone.
intro.zh: 柔性引线必须按安装后的运动工况选型，不能只凭手感。

knowledge.en: Fine stranding, core lay, jacket, support and termination jointly govern the moving assembly.
knowledge.zh: 细绞导体、芯线绞合、护套、支撑和端接共同决定活动组件的表现。

notes.en: Provide bend radius, cycle and torsion duty, connector drawings and environmental exposure.
notes.zh: 请提供弯曲半径、循环与扭转工况、接头图纸及环境条件。

delivery.en: Release the cable and its finished interfaces against project-specific first-article and acceptance checks.
delivery.zh: 按项目特定的首件与验收要求，放行线缆及完整接口。

intro.en: A flat profile helps routing only when conductor pitch, pin map and termination are specified together.
intro.zh: 扁平结构便于布线，但芯线间距、针脚表与端接方式必须共同定义。

knowledge.en: Round-conductor ribbon cable is not interchangeable with laminated FFC or printed-circuit FPC.
knowledge.zh: 圆导体排线不能与层压式 FFC 或印刷式 FPC 直接互换。

notes.en: Provide conductor count, pitch, gauge, connector part numbers, pin-1 view, route and bend duty.
notes.zh: 请提供芯数、间距、线规、连接器料号、1 号针视角、路径与弯折工况。

delivery.en: Release the complete labelled assembly against its approved pin map and first article.
delivery.zh: 按获认可的针脚表与首件放行完整标识组件。

intro.en: Cross-linked insulation must be specified as part of a complete cable and installation system.
intro.zh: 交联绝缘必须作为完整线缆与安装系统的一部分进行规定。

knowledge.en: XLPE is a material family, not a universal voltage, temperature, fire or outdoor rating.
knowledge.zh: XLPE 是材料家族，不是通用的电压、温度、阻燃或户外等级。

notes.en: Provide circuit, thermal duty, route, interfaces, cable part number and required evidence.
notes.zh: 请提供回路、热工况、路径、接口、线缆料号与所需证据。

delivery.en: Release records the exact insulation and cable construction, terminations and agreed checks.
delivery.zh: 放行记录包含准确的绝缘和线缆结构、端接与约定检验。

intro.en: Outdoor cable construction is selected around sunlight, water, temperature, route and installation.
intro.zh: 户外电缆结构围绕日照、水、温度、路径与安装方式选择。

knowledge.en: A black jacket alone does not prove outdoor suitability; cable, interfaces and supports form one exposed system.
knowledge.zh: 黑色护套不能单独证明户外适用性，线缆、接口与支撑构成完整暴露系统。

notes.en: Provide route, exposure, circuits, environment, connectors, sealing and required evidence.
notes.zh: 请提供路径、暴露、回路、环境、接口、密封与所需证据。

delivery.en: Release records the exact construction, installation and agreed validation.
delivery.zh: 放行记录包含准确结构、安装与约定验证。

intro.en: Measurement cables preserve low-level, precision and high-bandwidth signals between sensors and instruments.
intro.zh: 测量仪器电缆在传感器与仪器之间保持低电平、精密与高带宽信号。

knowledge.en: Resistance, capacitance, leakage, noise, impedance and motion can all change the measurement.
knowledge.zh: 电阻、电容、泄漏、噪声、阻抗与运动都可能改变测量结果。

notes.en: Provide sensor, range, bandwidth, accuracy, route, connectors and calibration boundary.
notes.zh: 请提供传感器、量程、带宽、精度、路径、接口与校准边界。

delivery.en: Release records the configured measurement lead and agreed evidence.
delivery.zh: 放行记录包含实际配置测量引线与约定证据。

intro.en: Medical project cables are engineered as components within the equipment safety and performance system.
intro.zh: 医疗项目电缆作为设备安全与性能体系内的元件进行设计。

knowledge.en: Equipment risk control, applied parts, signals, cleaning, usability and traceability define the cable.
knowledge.zh: 设备风险控制、应用部分、信号、清洁、可用性与追溯共同定义线缆。

notes.en: Provide equipment boundary, circuits, interface, handling, cleaning and validation plan.
notes.zh: 请提供设备边界、回路、接口、操作、清洁与验证计划。

delivery.en: Release records component identity, process, inspection and traceability.
delivery.zh: 放行记录包含元件身份、工艺、检验与追溯。

intro.en: Marine project cables serve shipboard power, control and instrumentation routes.
intro.zh: 船舶项目电缆服务于船上动力、控制与仪表路径。

knowledge.en: Circuit, route zone, class rules, fire strategy and marine exposure must be coordinated.
knowledge.zh: 回路、路径区域、船级规则、防火策略与海洋暴露必须协同。

notes.en: Provide vessel, class, cable schedule, route, environment and evidence.
notes.zh: 请提供船舶、船级、电缆清册、路径、环境与证据。

delivery.en: Release records the exact marine construction and installation scope.
delivery.zh: 放行记录包含准确船用结构与安装范围。

intro.en: Halogen-free cable specifications separate composition, gas acidity, smoke and flame performance.
intro.zh: 无卤电缆规格分别定义组成、气体酸度、烟密度与阻燃性能。

knowledge.en: One LSZH label does not prove every material and fire property.
knowledge.zh: 一个 LSZH 标签不能证明所有材料与火灾性能。

notes.en: Provide exact test methods, limits, cable construction and traceability.
notes.zh: 请提供准确试验方法、限值、线缆结构与追溯。

delivery.en: Release records the exact material construction and supporting reports.
delivery.zh: 放行记录包含准确材料结构与支持报告。

intro.en: Shielded twisted pair preserves balanced geometry and a controlled shield path.
intro.zh: 屏蔽双绞线保持平衡几何与受控屏蔽路径。

knowledge.en: Protocol, impedance, pair geometry, screen and connector bond define the channel together.
knowledge.zh: 协议、阻抗、线对几何、屏蔽与接口搭接共同定义通道。

notes.en: Provide protocol, rate, length, pair and screen construction, connectors and EMC plan.
notes.zh: 请提供协议、速率、长度、线对与屏蔽结构、接口及 EMC 方案。

delivery.en: Release records the complete balanced and shielded channel construction.
delivery.zh: 放行记录包含完整平衡与屏蔽通道结构。

intro.en: High-voltage cable systems coordinate voltage class, current, insulation, screen, sheath and accessories.
intro.zh: 高压电缆系统协同电压等级、电流、绝缘、屏蔽、护套与附件。

knowledge.en: Fixed and mobile high-voltage applications can require different standards and mechanical duties.
knowledge.zh: 固定与移动高压应用可能需要不同标准和机械工况。

notes.en: Provide power system, installation, environment, accessories and test plan.
notes.zh: 请提供电力系统、安装、环境、附件与试验计划。

delivery.en: Release records the complete cable and accessory system.
delivery.zh: 放行记录包含完整线缆与附件系统。

intro.en: Flame-retardant cable limits flame propagation under a defined test arrangement.
intro.zh: 阻燃电线电缆在规定试验排列下限制火焰蔓延。

knowledge.en: Single-cable, bunched-cable, fire-resistance, smoke and halogen tests answer different questions.
knowledge.zh: 单根、成束、耐火、烟密度与无卤试验回答不同问题。

notes.en: Provide exact fire-test method, installation, construction, marking and evidence.
notes.zh: 请提供准确燃烧试验方法、安装、结构、印字与证据。

delivery.en: Release records the exact cable identity and supporting fire-test evidence.
delivery.zh: 放行记录包含准确线缆身份与支持燃烧试验证据。

intro.en: Drag-chain cable is engineered around the complete repeated-motion profile.
intro.zh: 拖链电缆围绕完整重复运动谱进行设计。

knowledge.en: Travel, bend radius, speed, acceleration, carrier layout, construction and environment define service life together.
knowledge.zh: 行程、弯曲半径、速度、加速度、拖链布置、结构与环境共同定义寿命。

notes.en: Provide motion, circuits, carrier, endpoints, environment and cycle target.
notes.zh: 请提供运动、回路、拖链、端点、环境与循环目标。

delivery.en: Release records the complete moving cable system and agreed cycle evidence.
delivery.zh: 放行记录包含完整运动线缆系统与约定循环证据。

intro.en: Coaxial cable assemblies preserve controlled impedance through the cable, connector and every transition.
intro.zh: 同轴电缆组件在电缆、连接器与每一处过渡中维持受控阻抗。

knowledge.en: System impedance, frequency, loss, power, cable construction, connector interface, termination and validation must be defined together.
knowledge.zh: 系统阻抗、频率、损耗、功率、线缆结构、连接器界面、端接与验证必须共同定义。

notes.en: Provide equipment ports, impedance, frequency band, signal or power, length, cable limits, route, environment and test evidence.
notes.zh: 请提供设备端口、阻抗、频段、信号或功率、长度、线缆限制、路径、环境与测试证据。

delivery.en: Release records cable and connector part numbers, impedance, length, strip and termination controls, labels, environment and agreed electrical evidence.
delivery.zh: 放行记录包含线缆与连接器料号、阻抗、长度、剥线和端接控制、标签、环境及约定电气证据。

intro.en: CAN bus cable assemblies preserve a defined differential path between network nodes, connectors and transceivers.
intro.zh: CAN 总线电缆组件在网络节点、连接器与收发器之间保持规定的差分路径。

knowledge.en: The exact CAN profile, physical layer, topology, termination, pair construction and validation scope must be identified together.
knowledge.zh: 准确 CAN 配置、物理层、拓扑、终端、线对结构与验证范围必须共同识别。

notes.en: Provide device models, bit rates, topology, bus and stub lengths, termination locations, cable and connector specifications, environment and test requirements.
notes.zh: 请提供设备型号、速率、拓扑、主干与支线长度、终端位置、线缆和接口规范、环境与测试要求。

delivery.en: Release records the cable, pair and shield construction, connectors, pinout, topology, termination, lengths, process, traceability and agreed evidence.
delivery.zh: 放行记录包含线缆、线对与屏蔽结构、接口、针脚、拓扑、终端、长度、工艺、追溯与约定证据。

intro.en: Equipment wire carries power, control, safety and sensor circuits inside machines and industrial control panels.
intro.zh: 设备用电线在机器与工业控制柜内部承担动力、控制、安全和传感回路。

knowledge.en: MTW, AWM and field-installed wiring have different product and installation scopes; exact marking, location and governing standard must be reviewed.
knowledge.zh: MTW、AWM 与现场敷设电线具有不同产品和安装范围，必须审核准确印字、位置与适用标准。

notes.en: Provide the market, machine standard, circuit list, route map, exact wire designation, terminal system and validation plan.
notes.zh: 请提供目标市场、机器标准、回路表、路径图、准确线材型号、端接系统与验证方案。

delivery.en: Release records the wire identity, construction, cut and strip details, termination combination, routing, traceability and agreed checks.
delivery.zh: 放行记录包含线材身份、结构、裁线剥线、端接组合、布线路径、追溯与约定检查。

intro.en: Appliance wire and cable connect power, controls, motors, heaters and sensors across different thermal, moisture, movement and service zones inside equipment.
intro.zh: 电器电线电缆连接设备内部的电源、控制器、电机、加热器与传感器，并跨越不同温度、潮气、运动与维修区域。

knowledge.en: Internal wiring, AWM, flexible cord and the completed appliance have different specification and approval boundaries. The exact construction and use conditions must be identified.
knowledge.zh: 内部配线、AWM、柔性软线与完整电器具有不同规范和批准边界，必须明确准确结构与使用条件。

notes.en: Provide the destination market, appliance zone map, circuit loads, temperatures, exposure, movement, wire or cord designation, terminal system and validation plan.
notes.zh: 请提供目标市场、电器分区图、回路负载、温度、环境暴露、运动状态、线材或软线型号、端子系统与验证方案。

delivery.en: Release records the exact wire or cord, conductor and insulation construction, marking, termination, routing, protection, traceability and agreed assembly checks.
delivery.zh: 放行文件记录准确线材或软线、导体与绝缘结构、印字、端接、布线、防护、追溯及约定组件检查。

intro.en: Automotive primary wire is selected by circuit, route, installation zone, terminal system and governing specification rather than colour or nominal gauge alone.
intro.zh: 汽车电线应依据回路、路径、安装温区、端子系统和适用规范选择，不能只看颜色或标称线径。

knowledge.en: SAE J1128, the ISO 19642 series and customer specifications define different construction and validation frameworks. The exact type and revision must be identified for each project.
knowledge.zh: SAE J1128、ISO 19642 系列与客户规范分别建立不同结构和验证框架，每个项目都应明确准确类型与版本。

notes.en: Provide current, duty, voltage, route length, temperature zones, fluids, abrasion, terminal system, colour, marking and required cable specification.
notes.zh: 请提供电流、占空比、电压、路径长度、温区、介质、磨损、端子系统、颜色印字与所需线缆规范。

delivery.en: Release records the exact cable source and designation, conductor and insulation criteria, colour and marking, cut and strip dimensions, terminal pairing and agreed harness validation.
delivery.zh: 放行文件记录准确线材来源与型号、导体和绝缘判定、颜色印字、裁线剥线尺寸、端子配对与约定线束验证。

intro.en: Custom low-pressure molding integrates a defined electronic or cable insert with a thermoplastic protective body while controlling component exposure, interfaces, tooling contact and the complete assembly validation plan.
intro.zh: 定制低压成型把规定的电子或线缆嵌件与热塑性保护体整合，同时控制元件承受、接口边界、工装接触及完整组件验证计划。

knowledge.en: Low pressure describes a process approach, not an automatic guarantee of electronics safety, sealing or service life. Resin, insert, geometry and process window must be reviewed together.
knowledge.zh: 低压描述的是一种工艺路径，并不自动保证电子元件安全、密封或使用寿命；树脂、嵌件、几何与工艺窗口必须一起审核。

notes.en: Provide the bare insert, component map, keep-out zones, cable and connector interfaces, service environment, coverage boundary, quantity and required verification.
notes.zh: 请提供裸嵌件、元件地图、禁压区、线缆与连接器接口、使用环境、覆盖边界、数量及所需验证。

delivery.en: Release records the insert revision, resin identity, material preparation, tooling, process window, critical dimensions and agreed electrical, mechanical and environmental evidence.
delivery.zh: 放行文件记录嵌件版本、树脂身份、材料准备、工装、工艺窗口、关键尺寸与约定的电气、机械及环境证据。

title.zh: 高温包覆成型电缆组件

intro.en: Custom high-temperature overmolded cable assemblies coordinate the conductor system, insulation, connector or sensor insert, molding material, process temperature, sealing geometry and validation around the real thermal profile.
intro.zh: 定制高温包覆成型电缆组件围绕真实温度谱，协同定义导体体系、绝缘、连接器或传感器嵌件、成型材料、工艺温度、密封几何与验证。

knowledge.en: High temperature is not one material label. Continuous exposure, short peaks, thermal cycling, current-generated heat, fluids and the molding process itself can create different failure modes.
knowledge.zh: 高温不是一个材料标签。持续暴露、短时峰值、冷热循环、电流自发热、介质以及成型工艺本身，会产生不同失效模式。

notes.en: Provide the operating and peak temperatures at every zone, dwell and cycle profile, cable and insert materials, circuits, fluids, sealing target, mounting and required test method.
notes.zh: 请提供各温区工作与峰值温度、停留与循环谱、线缆和嵌件材料、回路、介质、密封目标、安装与所需试验方法。

delivery.en: Release records the material identities, preconditioning, tooling, process window, critical dimensions and agreed electrical, mechanical, sealing and thermal evidence.
delivery.zh: 放行文件记录材料身份、预处理、工装、工艺窗口、关键尺寸与约定的电气、机械、密封及热学证据。

displayTitle.zh: 高温包覆成型电缆组件

intro.en: Custom spiral coiled cable assemblies balance retracted package, working extension, restoring force, cable construction, endpoints and a defined motion cycle.
intro.zh: 定制螺旋卷线电缆组件需要平衡收缩包络、工作拉伸、回弹力、线缆结构、端点与明确动作循环。

knowledge.en: A coiled cord is a complete moving cable system; extension ratio, force and life cannot be selected independently.
knowledge.zh: 卷线是一套完整运动线缆系统，拉伸倍率、作用力与寿命不能相互独立选择。

notes.en: Provide retracted and working dimensions, coil geometry, both endpoints, circuits, restoring force, environment and motion profile.
notes.zh: 请提供收缩与工作尺寸、线圈几何、两端接口、回路、回弹力、环境与动作谱。

delivery.en: Release records the cable build, coil dimensions, tail directions, endpoints, forming conditions and agreed dimensional, electrical and cycle evidence.
delivery.zh: 放行文件记录线缆结构、线圈尺寸、尾段方向、端点、成型条件与约定的尺寸、电气及循环证据。

intro.en: Custom ultrasonic-welded branch harnesses combine specified conductors into compact solid-state splices through a validated preparation, tooling, parameter, protection and inspection process.
intro.zh: 定制超声波焊接分支线束通过经过验证的备线、工装、参数、防护与检验工艺，把规定导体组合成紧凑固相焊点。

knowledge.en: The released weld window belongs to the exact wire combination, tooling and equipment; a material or size change requires review.
knowledge.zh: 放行焊接窗口属于准确线材组合、工装与设备，更换材料或线径需要重新审核。

notes.en: Provide every wire material and area, circuit, branch geometry, strip and protection needs, environment, standard, quantity and validation limits.
notes.zh: 请提供每根线材与截面积、回路、分支几何、剥线和防护、环境、标准、数量与验证限值。

delivery.en: Release records wire stack, preparation, nugget limits, tooling, machine, parameter window, protection and inspection evidence.
delivery.zh: 放行文件记录线材叠放、备线、焊点限值、工装、设备、参数窗口、防护与检验证据。

intro.en: Custom EMI-shielded cable assemblies coordinate cable geometry, foil or braid, connector termination, bonding, ferrites and defined validation around the real noise source and coupling path.
intro.zh: 定制 EMI 屏蔽电缆组件围绕真实噪声源与耦合路径，协同定义线缆几何、铝箔或编织、连接器端接、搭接、铁氧体与验证。

knowledge.en: Shielding is a system path; coverage, endpoint continuity, enclosure bonding, routing and frequency determine performance.
knowledge.zh: 屏蔽是一条系统路径，覆盖、端点连续性、机壳搭接、走线与频率共同决定性能。

notes.en: Provide the source, victim circuit, frequency range, interfaces, route, grounding architecture, environment and target test method.
notes.zh: 请提供噪声源、受扰回路、频率范围、接口、走线、接地架构、环境与目标测试方法。

delivery.en: Release records pair geometry, shield construction, endpoint termination, ferrite details, grounding notes and agreed inspection or EMC evidence.
delivery.zh: 放行文件记录线对几何、屏蔽结构、端点端接、铁氧体细节、接地说明与约定检验或 EMC 证据。

intro.en: Custom FTDI cable assemblies combine USB conversion electronics, a defined serial electrical layer, purpose-built endpoints and project-specific validation.
intro.zh: 定制 FTDI 电缆组件将 USB 转换电子器件、明确串行电气层、专用端点与项目特定验证结合起来。

knowledge.en: An FTDI cable is an active electronic assembly; connector appearance does not prove protocol, voltage, pinout or driver identity.
knowledge.zh: FTDI 线属于有源电子组件，接口外观不能证明协议、电平、针脚或驱动身份。

notes.en: Provide the host, target equipment, pin map, serial layer, I/O voltage, signals, driver behavior, protection and validation method.
notes.zh: 请提供主机、目标设备、针脚表、串行电气层、I/O 电平、信号、驱动行为、防护与验证方法。

delivery.en: Release records electronics, programmed configuration, cable BOM, endpoints, circuit map, labels and agreed passive and active tests.
delivery.zh: 放行文件记录电子器件、编程配置、线缆 BOM、端点、回路图、标签及约定的被动与有源测试。

intro.en: Custom waterproof wire harnesses are developed as complete sealed systems around the real exposure, mating state, cable entries, branches and agreed validation.
intro.zh: 定制防水设计线束需要围绕真实暴露、插合状态、出线、分支与约定验证，作为完整密封系统开发。

knowledge.en: IP67, IP68 and IP69K are different defined test questions; a component rating does not automatically transfer to a complete harness.
knowledge.zh: IP67、IP68 与 IP69K 对应不同规定试验，元件等级不会自动转移到完整线束。

notes.en: Provide both mating interfaces, pin map, cable diameters, unused cavities, orientation, exposure, movement and required test method.
notes.zh: 请提供对插两端、针脚表、线缆外径、空腔、方向、暴露、运动与所需试验方法。

delivery.en: Release records the sealing stack, preparation dimensions, assembly controls and project-specific evidence.
delivery.zh: 放行记录密封链、备线尺寸、装配控制与项目特定证据。

intro.en: Custom panel-mount and bulkhead cable assemblies turn a cable end into a defined equipment interface, with the connector, cutout, hardware, seal, cable construction and validation engineered together.
intro.zh: 定制面板安装与隔板电缆组件，将线端变成边界清晰的设备接口，并将连接器、开孔、五金、密封、线缆结构与验证协同开发。

knowledge.en: Panel mounting describes installation, not signal capability, ingress protection or an interchangeable connector family.
knowledge.zh: 面板安装描述安装方式，并不自动代表信号能力、防护等级或通用接口。

notes.en: Provide the exact interface, panel material and thickness, cutout drawing, mounting side, hardware, route, environment and test requirements.
notes.zh: 请提供准确接口、面板材料与厚度、开孔图、安装方向、紧固件、路径、环境及测试要求。

delivery.en: Approve mechanical fit, interface sample, sealing stack, circuit map and project-specific test evidence before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 重复生产前确认机械配合、接口样件、密封叠层、回路图及项目特定测试证据。

intro.en: Custom Micro-D cable assemblies for compact aerospace, defense, instrumentation, medical and industrial electronics, with defined interface, circuit map, cable construction, retention, shielding and inspection.
intro.zh: 面向紧凑型航空航天、国防、仪器、医疗及工业电子设备定制 Micro-D 电缆组件，明确接口、回路图、线缆结构、锁紧、屏蔽与检验要求。

knowledge.en: Micro-D identifies a miniature connector family, not a complete cable or qualification statement.
knowledge.zh: Micro-D 标识微型连接器家族，并不等于完整电缆规范或资质声明。

notes.en: Provide exact mating references, contact arrangement, wiring view, cable construction, hardware, route and acceptance requirements.
notes.zh: 请提供准确对插料号、触点排列、接线视图、线缆结构、锁紧件、路径及验收要求。

delivery.en: Approve the interface schedule, termination sample, mechanical configuration and electrical inspection evidence before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 重复生产前确认接口清单、端接样品、机械配置与电气检验证据。

intro.en: Custom FFC and FPC cable assemblies for displays, cameras, control panels and compact equipment, with defined pitch, contact side, tail geometry, mating, routing and inspection.
intro.zh: 面向显示、摄像、控制面板与紧凑设备定制 FFC 和 FPC 电缆组件，明确节距、触点面、尾端几何、插接、布线与检验要求。

knowledge.en: FFC and FPC are related flexible interconnects, but their construction, thickness, copper geometry and connector compatibility are not interchangeable by name.
knowledge.zh: FFC 与 FPC 都属于柔性互连，但结构、厚度、铜路几何及接头兼容性不能仅凭名称互换。

notes.en: Provide both endpoint references, pitch, circuits, contact-side views, tail dimensions, installed route, motion duty and inspection requirements.
notes.zh: 请提供两端接口、节距、回路数、触点面视图、尾端尺寸、安装路径、运动工况与检验要求。

delivery.en: Approve the cable drawing, connector system, mating method, routing sample and electrical evidence before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 重复生产前确认线缆图纸、接头体系、对插方法、布线样品与电气证据。

intro.en: Custom IDC ribbon cable assemblies for board-to-board, panel and internal equipment connections with defined cable geometry, orientation, tooling and inspection.
intro.zh: 面向板间、面板及设备内部连接定制 IDC 扁平排线组件，明确线缆几何、方向、工装与检验要求。

knowledge.en: IDC is a termination method, not one universal connector or cable specification.
knowledge.zh: IDC 是端接方法，并不是一种通用接头或排线规范。

notes.en: Provide the mating interface, pitch, circuit count, AWG, pin map, orientation, dimensions, route and test requirements.
notes.zh: 请提供对插接口、节距、回路数、AWG、针脚表、方向、尺寸、路径与测试要求。

delivery.en: Approve cable, connectors, tooling, first-article orientation and continuity evidence before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 重复生产前确认排线、接头、工装、首件方向与导通证据。

intro.en: Custom PTFE-insulated wire and cable assemblies for high-temperature instruments, sensors, heaters and compact equipment, with defined materials, stripping, termination and inspection.
intro.zh: 面向高温仪器、传感器、加热设备与紧凑装置定制 PTFE 绝缘电线及电缆组件，明确材料、剥线、端接与检验要求。

knowledge.en: PTFE is a material family identifier, not a complete wire or termination specification.
knowledge.zh: PTFE 是材料体系标识，并不是完整的线材或端接规范。

notes.en: Provide the exact wire specification, conductor construction, terminal system, route, temperature zones and test requirements.
notes.zh: 请提供准确线材规范、导体结构、端子体系、布线路径、温区及试验要求。

delivery.en: Approve materials, tooling, first article and controlled inspection evidence before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 重复生产前确认物料、工装、首件及受控检验证据。

intro.en: Custom molded cable exits that manage pull, bend and torsion through coordinated geometry, resin compatibility, insert control and validation.
intro.zh: 通过协同几何、树脂相容性、嵌件控制与验证，定制管理拉力、弯曲与扭转的注塑出线结构。

knowledge.en: A cable boot is a controlled mechanical transition between a rigid interface and a flexible cable.
knowledge.zh: 线缆护套是刚性接口与柔性线缆之间的受控机械过渡。

notes.en: Provide insert and cable drawings, jacket construction, installed bend envelope, environment and test method.
notes.zh: 提供嵌件与线缆图纸、护套结构、安装弯曲包络、环境与试验方法。

delivery.en: Approve tooling, first article, critical dimensions and mechanical/electrical evidence before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 重复生产前确认模具、首件、关键尺寸以及机械与电气证据。

intro.en: Custom fine-pitch wire-to-board and compact sensor harnesses using project-approved 32AWG or other fine conductors.
intro.zh: 采用项目认可的 32AWG 或其他细导体制作细间距板端与紧凑传感线束。

knowledge.en: Fine geometry requires exact control of contact, wire, stripping, crimping, insertion and strain relief.
knowledge.zh: 精细几何需要准确控制触点、线材、剥线、压接、装壳与应力释放。

notes.en: Provide complete connector references, wire construction, circuit map, routing envelope and inspection limits.
notes.zh: 提供完整接口料号、线材结构、回路图、布线包络与检验限值。

delivery.en: Approve the crimp setup, sample, magnified inspection and electrical test records before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 重复生产前确认压接设置、样品、放大检验与电气测试记录。

intro.en: Custom fuse-holder, battery-feed and power-distribution harnesses built around specified Littelfuse or Eaton Bussmann components.
intro.zh: 围绕指定 Littelfuse 或 Eaton Bussmann 元件制作熔断器座、电池馈电与配电线束。

knowledge.en: Fuse, holder, conductor, busbar, enclosure and fault conditions form one protection system.
knowledge.zh: 熔断器、底座、导体、母排、外壳与故障条件共同构成保护系统。

notes.en: Provide exact part numbers, circuit duty, fault current, cable sizes, environment and validation requirements.
notes.zh: 提供准确料号、回路工况、故障电流、线缆规格、环境与验证要求。

delivery.en: Approve the schematic, BOM, sample, torque and electrical inspection records before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 重复生产前确认原理图、BOM、样品、扭矩及电气检验记录。

intro.en: Custom wire harnesses using specified Panduit terminals, cable ties, identification and routing components, reviewed by exact part number, material and installation method.
intro.zh: 采用指定 Panduit 端子、扎带、标识及布线部件制作定制线束，并按准确料号、材料与安装方法审核。

knowledge.en: A component family name does not define a complete harness; control the circuit, conductor, route, installation and acceptance method together.
knowledge.zh: 部件系列名称不能定义完整线束，仍需共同控制回路、导体、路径、安装与验收方法。

notes.en: Provide original part numbers, wire range, bundle diameter, environment, drawings and the approved substitution boundary.
notes.zh: 提供原始料号、适用线径、束径、环境、图纸及认可替代边界。

delivery.en: Approve the component schedule, harness-board baseline, workmanship sample and inspection record before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 重复生产前确认部件清单、线束板基准、工艺样品及检验记录。

intro.en: Custom Phoenix-interface terminal, sensor and equipment harnesses, with defined pinouts, conductor preparation and installation requirements.
intro.zh: 定制 Phoenix 接口端子、传感器及设备线束，明确针脚、导体处理及安装要求。

knowledge.en: Identify the exact terminal, circular or heavy-duty interface before defining conductor preparation, protection and test requirements.
knowledge.zh: 先识别准确的端子、圆形或重载接口，再定义导体处理、防护与检验要求。

notes.en: Provide the mating reference, wiring view, conductor range, installation environment and required approval method.
notes.zh: 提供对插料号、接线视图、导体范围、安装环境及所需认可方法。

delivery.en: Approve the interface schedule, workmanship sample and controlled inspection record before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 重复生产前认可接口清单、工艺样品及受控检验记录。

intro.en: Custom Binder-interface sensor, data and equipment cables, with specified coding, pinouts, materials and installation support.
intro.zh: 定制 Binder 接口传感、数据及设备电缆，明确编码、针脚、材料与安装支撑。

knowledge.en: Select the exact family, coding and protection condition before defining the cable.
knowledge.zh: 定义电缆前，先选择准确系列、编码及防护条件。

notes.en: Provide mating references, wiring views, lengths and the actual environment.
notes.zh: 提供对插料号、接线视图、长度及实际环境。

delivery.en: Approve the sample and controlled material and inspection documents.
delivery.zh: 认可样品及受控物料、检验文件。

intro.en: Custom push-pull cable assemblies for instruments, equipment and removable modules, with defined mating parts, pinouts and strain relief.
intro.zh: 面向仪器、设备及可拆卸模块的定制推拉式电缆组件，明确对插件、针脚与应力释放。

knowledge.en: Match the connector series, cable construction and handling conditions.
knowledge.zh: 匹配接头系列、线缆结构及操作条件。

notes.en: Provide the full mating reference, circuit map, cable dimensions and environment.
notes.zh: 提供完整对插料号、回路表、线缆尺寸及环境。

delivery.en: Approve the sample and controlled specification before repeat manufacture.
delivery.zh: 重复制造前认可样品及受控规范。

intro.en: Custom FCI-interface harnesses for board wiring, power and equipment modules, with specified mating parts, pinouts and inspection.
intro.zh: 定制 FCI 接口线束，覆盖板端布线、供电及设备模块，明确对插件、针脚与检验。

knowledge.en: Identify the exact family and termination before selecting cable and protection.
knowledge.zh: 先识别具体系列及端接方式，再选择线材与防护。

notes.en: Provide mating references, circuit drawing, dimensions and operating conditions.
notes.zh: 提供对插料号、回路图、尺寸及工作条件。

delivery.en: Approve materials, samples and the released inspection plan before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 重复生产前认可材料、样品及放行检验方案。

intro.en: Custom JAE-interface wiring for vehicle controls, displays and equipment modules, with defined pinouts, materials and inspection.
intro.zh: 定制 JAE 接口布线，覆盖车载控制、显示及设备模块，明确针脚、材料和检验。

knowledge.en: Match the complete connector series, mating pair and application requirements.
knowledge.zh: 匹配完整接头系列、对插件及应用要求。

notes.en: Supply part numbers, pinout, dimensions, environment and required evidence.
notes.zh: 提供料号、针脚、尺寸、环境及所需证据。

delivery.en: Review materials and drawings, approve samples, then release controlled production.
delivery.zh: 审核材料与图纸，认可样品后放行受控生产。

intro.en: Custom Hirose-interface harnesses for board wiring, miniature coax and equipment connections, with documented routing, materials and inspection.
intro.zh: 定制 Hirose 接口线束，覆盖板内布线、微型同轴及设备连接，明确路径、材料与检验。

knowledge.en: Identify the complete series, mating pair and cable construction before selection.
knowledge.zh: 选型前确认完整系列、对插件及线缆结构。

notes.en: Provide pinout, mating parts, dimensions, environment and required evidence.
notes.zh: 提供针脚、对插件、尺寸、环境及证据要求。

delivery.en: Review the specification, confirm samples and release the production version.
delivery.zh: 审核规格，确认样品后放行生产版本。

intro.en: Project-defined Amphenol-interface cables and harnesses, with documented connector selection, materials, routing and inspection.
intro.zh: 按项目定义 Amphenol 接口电缆与线束，明确连接器选型、材料、布线及检验。

knowledge.en: Choose the exact family, mating references and cable construction; a brand name does not define the assembly.
knowledge.zh: 明确系列、对插料号及电缆结构，品牌名不能定义完整组件。

notes.en: Provide circuit mapping, dimensions, environment, quantities and required evidence.
notes.zh: 提供回路、尺寸、环境、数量及所需证据。

delivery.en: Review parts and tooling, confirm the first article and release repeat production.
delivery.zh: 审核零件与工装，确认首件后放行重复生产。

intro.en: Custom Aptiv-interface harnesses for vehicle and equipment projects, with defined circuits, materials, routing and inspection.
intro.zh: 面向车辆与设备项目的 Aptiv 接口定制线束，明确回路、材料、布线与检验要求。

knowledge.en: Weather-Pack, Metri-Pack and GT are distinct systems; match the complete mating references.
knowledge.zh: Weather-Pack、Metri-Pack 与 GT 是不同系统，需匹配完整对插型号。

notes.en: Confirm part references, pin mapping, wire dimensions, environment and quantities.
notes.zh: 确认零件料号、针脚映射、线材尺寸、环境与数量。

delivery.en: Approve the BOM, tooling and first article before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 认可物料表、工装和首件后，再开展重复生产。

intro.en: Application-specific DEUTSCH-interface harnesses for equipment and vehicle wiring, with matched housings, contacts, seals, branch layouts and inspection requirements.
intro.zh: 面向设备与车辆配线的 DEUTSCH 接口定制线束，成套匹配胶壳、端子、密封件、分支布局与检验要求。

knowledge.en: DT, DTM and DTP use different contact sizes. Circular HDP20/HD30 and single-pole DTHD also require exact identification.
knowledge.zh: DT、DTM 与 DTP 使用不同接点规格，圆形 HDP20／HD30 和单极 DTHD 同样需要准确识别。

notes.en: Provide full mating references, wire sizes and insulation diameters, pin map, dimensions, operating conditions and quantities.
notes.zh: 请提供完整对插型号、线径与绝缘外径、针脚表、尺寸、运行条件和数量。

delivery.en: Approve the component combination, tooling and first article before releasing repeat assembly and agreed verification.
delivery.zh: 认可零件组合、工装与首件后，再放行重复装配和约定验证。

intro.en: Custom JST-interface wiring for compact electronics, sensors, equipment and lighting, with series identification, defined pinouts and application-specific materials.
intro.zh: 面向紧凑电子、传感器、设备与照明的 JST 接口定制配线，明确系列、针脚定义及适用材料。

knowledge.en: JST identifies a manufacturer, not a universal plug. PH, XH, SH, GH, SM and JWPF differ in pitch, mating geometry and application limits.
knowledge.zh: JST 是制造商名称，不是通用插头。PH、XH、SH、GH、SM 和 JWPF 的间距、对插几何及应用限制各不相同。

notes.en: Send the mating part number, cavity view, circuit list, wire size, lengths, environmental conditions and required verification.
notes.zh: 请提供对插件型号、腔位视图、回路表、线径、长度、环境条件和所需验证。

delivery.en: Review the interface and BOM, confirm the first article, then manufacture and inspect against the approved documents.
delivery.zh: 审核接口及物料，确认首件后按认可文件制造与检验。

intro.en: Custom wire-to-board, wire-to-wire and equipment cable assemblies built around specified Molex interfaces, with defined circuits, materials and inspection requirements.
intro.zh: 围绕指定 Molex 接口开发线对板、线对线及设备电缆组件，明确回路、材料与检验要求。

knowledge.en: Molex is a manufacturer, not one plug size. Family, mating geometry, terminal and electrical duty must be identified together.
knowledge.zh: Molex 是制造商名称，不是一种插头尺寸。系列、对插几何、端子及电气工况需要一起识别。

notes.en: Provide full mating references, cavity views, circuit table, wire specification, dimensions, routing conditions and order quantities.
notes.zh: 请提供完整对插型号、腔位视图、接线表、线材规格、尺寸、布线条件与订购数量。

delivery.en: Confirm the BOM and interface, approve the sample and test plan, then release controlled assembly and agreed verification.
delivery.zh: 确认物料与接口，认可样品及测试计划后，执行受控装配与约定验证。

intro.en: Custom connector leads and harness assemblies defined around specified TE / AMP interfaces, terminal systems, wire, sealing and installation requirements.
intro.zh: 围绕指定 TE / AMP 接口、端子系统、线材、密封与安装要求，开发定制连接线和线束组件。

knowledge.en: A brand or housing shape is not an interchangeability specification. Confirm the complete mating system and approved bill of materials.
knowledge.zh: 品牌名称或壳体外形不是互换规格，需要确认完整对插系统及认可物料清单。

notes.en: Send full part numbers, mating drawings, cavity assignment, wire size and insulation diameter, environment, quantity and inspection requirements.
notes.zh: 请提供完整料号、对插图纸、腔位定义、线径与绝缘外径、使用环境、数量及检验要求。

delivery.en: Review parts and tooling, approve first articles, then produce against controlled drawings and the agreed inspection plan.
delivery.zh: 审核物料与工装，完成首件认可后，按受控图纸和约定检验计划生产。

intro.en: Turbo actuator connector leads, repair pigtails and custom engine-side harnesses, defined by the exact actuator interface, circuit, materials and installation route.
intro.zh: 涡轮执行器连接线、维修尾线与定制发动机侧线束，依据准确的执行器接口、回路、材料和安装路线开发。

knowledge.en: The harness carries the specified power and signal paths. It does not replace actuator electronics, turbocharger diagnosis or model-specific calibration.
knowledge.zh: 线束承载规定的供电与信号路径，不能替代执行器电子系统、增压器诊断或具体型号的标定。

notes.en: Provide actuator and turbocharger part numbers, connector views, circuit definition, cable length, routing environment and quantity.
notes.zh: 请提供执行器与增压器料号、接口照片、回路定义、线长、布线环境及数量。

delivery.en: Confirm mating components and wiring, approve the sample, then release controlled production and agreed inspection records.
delivery.zh: 确认对插件及接线，完成样件认可后，按受控文件生产并提交约定检验记录。

intro.en: Custom automotive antenna, camera and display interconnects, with FAKRA coaxial and HSD differential paths specified separately for the actual equipment.
intro.zh: 面向车载天线、摄像头与显示设备定制连接组件，依据实际设备分别定义 FAKRA 同轴路径与 HSD 差分路径。

knowledge.en: Connector family, signaling method and cable impedance describe different parts of the link. A keyed housing is not proof of electrical compatibility.
knowledge.zh: 连接器系列、信号方式与线缆阻抗描述链路的不同部分，带防错键的壳体不等于电气兼容证明。

notes.en: Provide exact connector codes, cable specification, channel requirements, serializer/deserializer references and any power-over-coax conditions.
notes.zh: 请提供准确接头编码、线缆规格、通道要求、串行器与解串器型号，以及可能存在的同轴供电条件。

delivery.en: Confirm the complete channel, assembly geometry, sample checks and agreed RF or differential measurements before release.
delivery.zh: 放行前确认完整通道、装配形状、样件检查及约定的射频或差分测量。

intro.en: Custom GNSS antenna leads, tracker power looms and vehicle-specific communication adapters, coordinated around the receiver, vehicle interface and installation.
intro.zh: 围绕接收设备、车辆接口与安装位置，定制 GNSS 天线连接线、定位器电源线束及车型专用通信转接组件。

knowledge.en: A vehicle tracking installation combines separate RF, power and data paths. Their cable, connector and verification requirements are not interchangeable.
knowledge.zh: 车辆定位安装同时涉及射频、供电与数据路径，这几种回路的线缆、接头和验证要求不能混用。

notes.en: Confirm exact receiver and vehicle references, pin assignments, antenna bias, RF loss, supply duty and permitted data access before selecting an adapter.
notes.zh: 选配转接组件前，确认接收器与车型资料、针脚、天线偏置供电、射频损耗、供电工况及允许的数据访问方式。

delivery.en: Release interface drawings, prototype fit checks, circuit tests and applicable RF checks before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 重复生产前，确认接口图、样件装配、回路测试与适用射频检查。

intro.en: Project-reviewed high-voltage interconnections for electrified equipment, with defined insulation, shielding, interlock and validation requirements.
intro.zh: 面向电气化设备，按项目审核绝缘、屏蔽、互锁与验证要求的高压连接组件。

knowledge.en: Voltage withstand, temperature rise, shielding and HVIL are separate requirements that must work together.
knowledge.zh: 绝缘耐受、温升、屏蔽与高压互锁是不同要求，需要在系统中协调。

notes.en: High-voltage projects require engineering and validation review before quotation. This page is not an energized-service procedure.
notes.zh: 高压项目报价前需完成工程与验证条件审核，本页不是带电维修操作指南。

delivery.en: Agree component sources, tooling, drawings, samples and verification scope before releasing a production build.
delivery.zh: 生产放行前确认物料来源、工装、图纸、样件及验证范围。

intro.en: Custom battery terminal leads, starter feeds, earth straps and jumper assemblies, defined by the complete current path and installation.
intro.zh: 围绕完整电流路径与安装空间，定制电瓶端子线、起动机供电线、接地搭接线及跨接组件。

knowledge.en: Conductor area, termination, length and operating duty jointly determine voltage drop and thermal behavior.
knowledge.zh: 导体截面、端接质量、长度和工作周期共同决定压降与温升。

notes.en: Define permanent installation separately from temporary jump starting. Follow the vehicle manufacturer's instructions and approved connection points.
notes.zh: 永久安装线路与临时跨接起动应分别定义。操作遵循车辆制造商说明与指定连接点。

delivery.en: Release drawings, material part numbers, polarity, branch dimensions and inspection requirements before production.
delivery.zh: 生产前确认图纸、物料型号、极性、分支尺寸及检验要求。

intro.en: Custom relay and fuse-box harnesses connect protected power feeds, switching circuits and vehicle loads in a serviceable assembly.
intro.zh: 继电器与保险丝盒线束连接受保护馈线、开关控制回路与车辆负载，组成便于安装和维护的配电组件。

knowledge.en: Fuse selection, contact duty, conductor capacity, coil suppression and enclosure temperature must be coordinated.
knowledge.zh: 熔断器、触点任务、导体容量、线圈抑制与盒内温度需要协调设计。

notes.en: Provide the voltage, circuit diagram, load profile, connector details, mounting space and validation requirements.
notes.zh: 请提供电压、原理图、负载曲线、连接器资料、安装空间与验证要求。

delivery.en: Released drawings, material approval, sample validation and controlled assembly define each production version.
delivery.zh: 通过图纸放行、物料认可、样品验证与受控组装定义每个生产版本。

intro.en: Industrial equipment harnesses connect control cabinets, sensors, actuators, motors, I/O modules and field devices inside a machine or production line. The harness is defined by the equipment layout and electrical drawing rather than by a universal model.
intro.zh: 工业设备线束用于连接控制柜、传感器、执行器、电机、I/O模块和现场设备。它不是通用固定型号，而是依据设备布局、电气图和安装路径定义。

knowledge.en: Power, control and sensitive signal circuits may require different routing, conductor, shielding and identification strategies. Branch position, service loop, bend allowance and strain relief affect whether the harness can be installed and maintained correctly.
knowledge.zh: 动力、控制与敏感信号回路可能需要不同的布线、导体、屏蔽和标识方案。分支位置、检修余量、弯曲空间和应力消除会直接影响安装与维护。

notes.en: Confirm the equipment layout, connector or terminal-block models, pin or terminal numbers, voltage and current, cable path, ambient temperature, oil or abrasion exposure and maintenance method. Similar-looking interfaces cannot be matched by appearance alone.
notes.zh: 需要确认设备布局、连接器或端子排型号、针脚或端子编号、电压电流、布线路径、环境温度、油污与磨损情况以及维护方式。外形相似的接口不能只凭外观匹配。

delivery.en: Engineering first reviews the drawing, BOM and routing constraints, then confirms materials and builds a sample. Branch dimensions, labels, connector orientation and continuity are checked against the approved sample before repeat production.
delivery.zh: 先审核图纸、BOM和布线限制，再确认物料并制作样品；经确认的分支尺寸、标签、接口方向和导通关系将作为后续重复生产的依据。

intro.en: Control panel harnesses organize the connections between switches, indicator lamps, relays, PLC or HMI modules, terminal blocks and external equipment. They are designed around the panel layout and service method.
intro.zh: 控制面板线束用于组织开关、指示灯、继电器、PLC或HMI模块、端子排与外部设备之间的连接，结构围绕面板布局和检修方式设计。

knowledge.en: Panel depth, component spacing, door movement and terminal access determine branch length and exit direction. Clear wire numbers, terminal labels and defined connector keying reduce assembly and maintenance errors.
knowledge.zh: 面板深度、器件间距、柜门运动和端子操作空间决定分支长度与出线方向。清晰的线号、端子标识和防错接口有助于减少装配与检修错误。

notes.en: Provide the panel drawing, component model list, terminal schedule, door or hinge movement, wire-number rules and connection table. Confirm whether the harness is supplied loose, mounted to the panel or delivered with specified accessories.
notes.zh: 建议提供面板图、器件型号清单、端子表、柜门或铰链运动范围、线号规则和接线表，并确认线束是散装交付、面板预装还是连同指定附件交付。

delivery.en: After a layout and terminal review, a first assembly is checked on the actual panel or an agreed fixture. Terminal positions, labels, branch lengths and continuity are recorded before batch assembly.
delivery.zh: 完成布局与端子审核后，首件可在实际面板或约定工装上核对；端子位置、标签、分支长度和导通结果确认后再进行批量装配。

intro.en: Robotic harnesses carry power, control or sensor signals through moving axes, robot arms or end-of-arm tooling. Static cable construction is not automatically suitable for repeated bending or torsion.
intro.zh: 机器人线束用于在运动轴、机械臂或末端工具之间传输电源、控制或传感信号。适用于固定安装的线材，不一定适合持续弯折或扭转。

knowledge.en: Repeated bending, torsion and drag-chain travel create different mechanical loads. Bend radius, torsion angle, travel length, acceleration, clamping position and connector strain relief must be considered as one routing system.
knowledge.zh: 往复弯折、扭转和拖链运动产生的机械载荷不同。弯曲半径、扭转角度、行程、加速度、固定位置和接口应力消除需要作为一套运动系统共同评估。

notes.en: Do not select only by conductor count. Provide the robot or axis layout, motion video or path, expected cycle range, available bend radius, torsion angle, cable carrier information and electrical function. Actual life must be validated under the project motion profile.
notes.zh: 不能只按芯数选型。应提供机器人或运动轴布局、运动视频或路径、预期循环次数范围、可用弯曲半径、扭转角度、拖链信息和电气功能；实际寿命需按项目运动工况验证。

delivery.en: The sample stage confirms routing length, clamp points and connector orientation before motion testing by the customer or an agreed method. Production specifications are frozen only after the sample and motion conditions are accepted.
delivery.zh: 样品阶段先确认布线长度、固定点和接口方向，再由客户或按约定方法进行运动验证；样品与运动条件确认后，才冻结量产规格。

intro.en: Instrument and sensor harnesses connect sensing elements, transmitters, gauges, acquisition modules and controllers. They may carry low-level analog signals, digital communication, excitation power or mixed circuits.
intro.zh: 仪表与传感器线束连接传感元件、变送器、仪表、采集模块和控制器，可能承载低电平模拟信号、数字通信、激励电源或混合回路。

knowledge.en: Signal type determines whether twisted pairs, shielding, drain wires or controlled grounding are needed. Shield termination, reference ground and separation from noisy power circuits must follow the equipment design rather than a generic rule.
knowledge.zh: 信号类型决定是否需要双绞、屏蔽、排流线或特定接地方式。屏蔽端接、参考地以及与干扰性动力回路的间距，应依据设备设计确定，不能套用单一规则。

notes.en: Provide the sensor and controller models, signal type, pin definition, supply voltage, connector orientation, required shielding and installation environment. For calibrated systems, define which calibration or functional checks remain the customer's responsibility.
notes.zh: 需要提供传感器与控制器型号、信号类型、针脚定义、供电电压、接口方向、屏蔽要求和安装环境；涉及校准的系统，还应明确哪些校准或功能验证由客户完成。

delivery.en: Pin routing, conductor and shield construction are reviewed before sampling. Continuity, insulation where specified, shield termination and labels are checked to the approved drawing; signal performance testing is agreed separately when required.
delivery.zh: 打样前审核针脚路径、导体与屏蔽结构；依据确认图纸检查导通、约定的绝缘项目、屏蔽端接和标签，若需要信号性能测试则另行约定。

intro.en: Appliance harnesses distribute power and control signals among switches, heaters, motors, sensors, displays and control boards inside electrical equipment. Space, heat sources and assembly sequence strongly influence the design.
intro.zh: 电器设备线束在开关、加热器、电机、传感器、显示器和控制板之间分配电源与控制信号。内部空间、热源位置和装配顺序会明显影响结构。

knowledge.en: Conductor size, insulation, terminals and protection are selected from the actual current, temperature, movement and applicable product requirements. Routing near sharp edges or heat sources may require clips, sleeves, grommets or additional separation.
knowledge.zh: 导体规格、绝缘、端子和防护方式需要根据实际电流、温度、运动情况及适用产品要求确定。靠近锐边或热源的布线可能需要卡扣、套管、护线圈或额外隔离。

notes.en: Provide the appliance model or internal layout, circuit diagram, component interfaces, current and temperature information, assembly sequence and required standard or document. A category listing does not replace project-specific safety or compliance review.
notes.zh: 建议提供设备型号或内部布局、电路图、器件接口、电流与温度信息、装配顺序以及适用标准或文件。页面中的类别名称不能代替具体项目的安全与合规审核。

delivery.en: The engineering sample confirms fit, routing, terminal retention, labels and assembly sequence. Agreed electrical checks and workmanship criteria are recorded before repeat orders.
delivery.zh: 工程样品用于确认装配适配、布线、端子保持、标签和安装顺序；约定的电气检查与工艺验收标准会在重复订单前记录确认。

intro.en: Jumper harnesses are short interconnects used between boards, modules, terminal points or adjacent devices. Their simple appearance can hide different pin routes, orientation and current requirements.
intro.zh: 跳线线束通常用于电路板、模块、端子点或相邻设备之间的短距离连接。外观虽然简单，但针脚路径、方向和电流要求可能完全不同。

knowledge.en: A jumper may be straight-through, crossed, split or combined with specified components. Connector pitch, keying, terminal plating, conductor size and pull direction affect compatibility.
knowledge.zh: 跳线可能是直通、交叉、分支，也可能按要求集成指定元件。接口间距、防错结构、端子镀层、导体规格和受力方向都会影响兼容性。

notes.en: Confirm both mating interfaces, pin-to-pin table, insertion direction, length reference, current or signal function and whether a sample must be matched. Do not infer a straight-through connection from the connector count.
notes.zh: 需要确认两端对插接口、针脚对应表、插入方向、长度基准、电流或信号功能以及是否需要匹配样品，不能因为两端芯数相同就默认直通。

delivery.en: A first article is built to the approved pin table and dimensional reference. Continuity, polarity where applicable, terminal retention and appearance are checked before the batch is released.
delivery.zh: 首件依据确认的针脚表和尺寸基准制作，并检查导通、适用时的极性、端子保持与外观，确认后再放行批量生产。

intro.en: Pigtail and branch harnesses divide one main connection into multiple tails or provide a service lead from an existing circuit. Branch geometry and splice construction are central to the design.
intro.zh: 尾线与分支线束把一个主连接分成多个尾端，或从现有回路引出维修与功能支路。分支几何尺寸和接点结构是设计核心。

knowledge.en: Branch current, conductor combination, splice location, sealing and strain relief must be reviewed together. The joint method must suit the conductor construction and project acceptance criteria.
knowledge.zh: 分支电流、导体组合、接点位置、密封和应力防护需要一起审核。接点方式必须适配导体结构和项目验收标准。

notes.en: Provide a branch drawing with datum points, each tail length, conductor sizes, load information, mandatory splice method, sealing requirement and connector orientation. Clarify whether dimensions are measured before or after forming.
notes.zh: 应提供带基准点的分支图、各尾端长度、导体规格、负载信息、指定的接点方式、密封要求和接口方向，并明确尺寸是在成型前还是成型后测量。

delivery.en: The sample is checked on a branch board or dimensional template. Continuity, branch dimensions, splice protection, labels and mechanical checks are performed to the agreed project plan.
delivery.zh: 样品可在分支板或尺寸模板上核对；导通、分支尺寸、接点防护、标签以及机械项目按双方确认的项目计划执行。

intro.en: A turnkey harness project covers a more complete supply scope: material sourcing, connector and accessory preparation, assembly, labeling, inspection and packed delivery to an agreed drawing and BOM.
intro.zh: 交钥匙线束项目覆盖更完整的供货范围，包括物料采购、连接器与附件准备、线束装配、标签、检验以及依据约定图纸和BOM包装交付。

knowledge.en: The key difference is configuration control. Drawings, BOM revisions, approved sources, substitutions, tooling, test methods, labels and packing instructions must stay aligned so a repeat order reproduces the approved assembly.
knowledge.zh: 交钥匙项目的关键是配置管理。图纸、BOM版本、认可来源、替代规则、工装、测试方法、标签和包装说明必须保持一致，才能让重复订单复现确认样品。

notes.en: Define the exact supply boundary, customer-supplied parts, approved manufacturers, substitution approval process, inspection records, packing unit and revision authority. Missing ownership rules create schedule and compatibility risk.
notes.zh: 需要明确供货边界、客供物料、认可制造商、替代审批流程、检验记录、包装单位和版本批准权限。责任边界不清会增加进度与兼容风险。

delivery.en: The project normally passes through DFM review, BOM and source confirmation, first-article build, customer approval and controlled production release. Future changes are handled through a recorded revision process.
delivery.zh: 项目通常经过可制造性审核、BOM与来源确认、首件制作、客户批准和受控量产放行；后续变更通过可追踪的版本流程处理。

intro.en: Braided protection harnesses use textile, expandable, metal or other specified braiding to protect or organize a cable bundle. Protective braid and conductive shielding braid serve different functions and are not interchangeable.
intro.zh: 编织防护线束使用纺织、扩张、金属或其他指定编织层保护和整理线束。机械防护编织层与导电屏蔽编织层用途不同，不能混为一谈。

knowledge.en: Material, coverage, expansion range, abrasion behavior, temperature, cut-edge treatment and branch transitions determine whether the braid can be assembled and maintained. Shielding braid additionally requires a defined termination and grounding approach.
knowledge.zh: 材料、覆盖率、扩张范围、耐磨表现、温度、切口处理和分支过渡决定编织层是否便于装配与维护；屏蔽编织层还必须明确端接和接地方式。

notes.en: State whether the goal is abrasion protection, appearance, bundle management or electrical shielding. Provide maximum bundle diameter, branch positions, temperature and chemical exposure, termination method and required coverage or test reference.
notes.zh: 应说明目标是耐磨、外观、束线管理还是电气屏蔽，并提供最大束径、分支位置、温度与化学环境、端接方式以及要求的覆盖率或测试依据。

delivery.en: Material and braid size are confirmed on a representative sample. Cut edges, branch transitions, end fixation, flexibility and appearance are reviewed before the protection process is released for production.
delivery.zh: 通过代表性样品确认编织材料与规格，再核对切口、分支过渡、端部固定、柔性和外观，确认后放行防护工序。

intro.en: Prototype and small-batch harnesses support engineering validation, replacement trials, pilot equipment and low-volume projects where the design may still change. The objective is to learn quickly without losing configuration control.
intro.zh: 样品与小批量线束适用于工程验证、替代试验、试制设备和低用量项目，设计在这一阶段可能仍会调整，重点是在快速验证的同时保持版本受控。

knowledge.en: Prototype materials and manual processes may differ from the final production route. Temporary substitutions, hand-built features and unvalidated assumptions should be identified so a functional sample is not mistaken for a frozen mass-production specification.
knowledge.zh: 样品物料和手工作业方式可能与最终量产工艺不同。临时替代、手工结构或尚未验证的假设应明确记录，避免把通过功能试验的样品误认为已经冻结的量产规格。

notes.en: Provide the current drawing revision, test purpose, must-use parts, acceptable temporary substitutions, quantity, target date and expected next revision. Clarify which dimensions or functions are still under evaluation.
notes.zh: 建议提供当前图纸版本、测试目的、必须使用的物料、可接受的临时替代、数量、目标日期和下一版计划，并说明哪些尺寸或功能仍在验证。

delivery.en: A review record identifies assumptions and open points before the sample is built. Feedback is converted into a revised drawing or BOM, and repeat production starts only from the customer-approved revision.
delivery.zh: 打样前通过审核记录列出假设与待确认项；样品反馈转化为新版图纸或BOM，重复生产只依据客户批准的版本启动。

intro.en: Outdoor waterproof harnesses are designed for equipment exposed to rain, splash, dust, condensation or other defined environments. Waterproof performance belongs to the complete mated connection and cable-entry system, not to the cable alone.
intro.zh: 户外防水线束面向雨水、飞溅、灰尘、冷凝或其他明确环境。防水性能属于完整的插合接口、密封件与出线系统，不能只看线材本身。

knowledge.en: Housing seals, individual wire seals, cavity plugs, connector locks, cable jackets, backshells, branch joints and strain relief all influence ingress protection. Bend loading or an incorrect cable diameter can disturb a rear seal.
knowledge.zh: 壳体密封、单线密封塞、堵孔件、锁止、线缆护套、尾壳、分支接点和应力消除都会影响防护效果；弯曲受力或线径不匹配也可能破坏尾部密封。

notes.en: Define the actual exposure, target protection level or test method, mated connector system, cable diameter, unused cavities, mounting direction, branch treatment and responsibility for final installed validation.
notes.zh: 需要明确实际暴露环境、目标防护等级或测试方法、完整对插系统、线缆外径、空腔处理、安装方向、分支防护以及最终装机验证责任。

delivery.en: The sealing stack and cable-entry dimensions are reviewed before the sample. Assembly controls, continuity and any agreed ingress test are recorded for the project; no universal waterproof claim is made outside that validated configuration.
delivery.zh: 打样前审核密封组合和出线尺寸，项目中记录装配控制、导通和约定的防护测试；未经该配置验证，不作通用防水承诺。

intro.en: Low-voltage new-energy harnesses serve auxiliary controllers, sensors, pumps, fans, lighting, communication or diagnostic functions in electric or new-energy equipment. This category does not mean high-voltage traction or battery power cabling.
intro.zh: 新能源低压线束用于电动或新能源设备中的辅助控制器、传感器、泵、风扇、照明、通信或诊断功能。本类别不等同于高压动力或电池主回路线束。

knowledge.en: Low-voltage circuits can still combine power, communication and sensitive signals. Connector keying, current path, fuse strategy, grounding, shielding, sealing and routing must match the actual controller and electrical architecture.
knowledge.zh: 低压系统仍可能同时包含供电、通信和敏感信号。接口防错、电流路径、保险策略、接地、屏蔽、密封和布线必须与实际控制器及电气架构匹配。

notes.en: Provide the platform and controller, nominal and maximum voltage, current by circuit, communication type, pin map, connector references, installation zone and applicable customer specification. High-voltage requests require a separate capability and compliance review.
notes.zh: 需要提供平台与控制器、标称和最高电压、各回路电流、通信类型、针脚图、接口资料、安装区域和客户规范；高压需求必须另行进行能力与合规审核。

delivery.en: Engineering confirms the low-voltage boundary, interfaces and inspection plan before sampling. The approved sample, pin table, labels and agreed electrical checks become the controlled reference for production.
delivery.zh: 打样前确认低压范围、接口和检验计划；获批样品、针脚表、标签和约定的电气检查项目作为受控量产依据。

intro.en: Overmolded cable assemblies encapsulate the connector-to-cable transition with a selected thermoplastic or elastomer to provide defined strain relief, sealing, touch protection, geometry and appearance. The result depends on the complete interface, cable jacket, molding material, insert preparation and process window.
intro.zh: 包覆成型电缆组件使用指定热塑性材料或弹性体包覆连接器与线缆的过渡区域，以形成明确的应力消除、密封、触摸防护、几何和外观。最终效果取决于完整接口、线缆护套、包胶材料、嵌件处理与工艺窗口。

knowledge.en: A durable overmold is not simply plastic placed around a connector. Resin compatibility, adhesion or mechanical locking, melt temperature, insert temperature, pressure, venting, wall thickness, cable movement and shrinkage all affect cracks, voids, flash, deformation and bond stability.
knowledge.zh: 可靠包胶并不是简单地在连接器外面注塑。树脂兼容性、粘接或机械锁固、熔体温度、嵌件温度、压力、排气、壁厚、线缆移动与收缩都会影响开裂、气孔、飞边、变形和结合稳定性。

notes.en: Provide both interfaces, pin map, cable construction, jacket material and diameter, required molded geometry, colour, hardness, environmental exposure, bend direction, pull loads, quantity and validation method. Existing tooling can be considered only after dimensional and functional review.
notes.zh: 建议提供两端接口、针脚、线缆结构、护套材料与外径、所需包胶几何、颜色、硬度、环境、弯曲方向、拉力、数量与验证方法。现有模具只有在尺寸和功能审核后才能考虑使用。

delivery.en: Engineering first reviews the electrical assembly and molding feasibility. A drawing defines insert position, datums, parting line, gate-sensitive surfaces and cable exit. Tooling, first-off samples, dimensional and electrical checks, agreed mechanical tests and production controls are approved in sequence.
delivery.zh: 工程首先审核电气组件与包胶可行性。图纸定义嵌件位置、基准、分型线、浇口敏感面与出线方向，再依次确认模具、首件、尺寸与电气检查、约定机械测试和生产控制。

intro.en: Circular connector cable assemblies cover threaded, bayonet, push-pull, panel-mount, inline, sealed and mixed-contact interfaces for power, signal, communication and sensor circuits. Each assembly is defined by its exact connector family, keying, contact arrangement, cable, backshell and installation environment.
intro.zh: 圆形连接器电缆组件覆盖螺纹、卡口、推拉、面板安装、线对线、密封与混合针芯接口，可承载电源、信号、通信和传感器回路。每条组件都由准确的连接器系列、键位、针芯排列、线缆、尾壳和安装环境共同定义。

knowledge.en: A similar shell diameter does not prove interchangeability. Coupling geometry, keys, insert layout, contact sex, terminal range, seals and backshell threads must all match the mating interface and cable construction.
knowledge.zh: 外壳直径相似并不能证明可以互换。锁紧几何、键位、绝缘体孔位、接触件性别、端子线径范围、密封件与尾部螺纹都必须匹配对插接口和线缆结构。

notes.en: Provide the connector series and part number when known, clear views of both mating faces and keying, a pin map, circuit ratings, cable length and structure, panel details, exit direction, environment, quantity and validation requirements.
notes.zh: 建议提供已知的连接器系列与料号、双方插合面和键位清晰照片、针脚定义、回路额定、线长与结构、面板资料、出线方向、环境、数量和验证要求。

delivery.en: Engineering freezes the interface, circuit map, cable and rear accessories before the first build. Termination, contact insertion, shield treatment, sealing and backshell assembly are inspected before continuity, mating, locking, dimensional and project-specific validation.
delivery.zh: 工程在首件前冻结接口、回路、线缆与尾部附件。端接、插针、屏蔽处理、密封和尾壳装配完成检查后，再进行导通、插合、锁紧、尺寸与项目专项验证。

intro.en: D-Sub cable assemblies extend far beyond a single nine-contact serial lead. Standard-density, high-density, mixed power and signal, panel-mount, inline, shielded, breakout and application-specific configurations are developed around the exact equipment interface, pin map, cable structure and installation limits.
intro.zh: D-Sub 电缆组件远不止常见的九针串口线。标准密度、高密度、混合电源与信号、面板安装、线对线、屏蔽、一分多及专用配置，都需要围绕准确设备接口、针脚定义、线缆结构和安装限制开发。

knowledge.en: Shell size, contact pattern, contact sex, viewing direction, jackscrews, hood, termination and shielding path all matter. A similar D-shaped interface or equal contact count does not prove interchangeability.
knowledge.zh: 外壳尺寸、触点排列、接触件性别、视图方向、固定螺钉、尾罩、端接方式与屏蔽路径都需要确认。D 形外观相似或针数相同并不能证明可以互换。

notes.en: Provide clear mating-face and wire-side photographs, the mating equipment, exact pin map, voltage and current, signal type, cable length and construction, hood and exit direction, fixing hardware, environment, quantity and validation requirements.
notes.zh: 建议提供插合面与接线面清晰照片、对插设备、准确针脚、电压电流、信号类型、线长与结构、尾罩与出线方向、固定硬件、环境、数量和验证要求。

delivery.en: Engineering freezes the connector, pin orientation, circuits, cable, hood and hardware before the first build. Termination and shield treatment are inspected before continuity, shorts, polarity, mating, locking, dimensions and project-specific signal or environmental validation.
delivery.zh: 工程在首件前冻结连接器、针脚方向、回路、线缆、尾罩和固定硬件。端接与屏蔽处理完成检查后，再进行导通、短路、极性、插合、锁紧、尺寸以及项目专项信号或环境验证。

intro.en: USB cable assemblies cover legacy Type-A and Type-B interfaces, Mini and Micro formats, reversible Type-C, panel-mounted extensions, molded leads, charging-only constructions, high-speed data paths and USB-to-equipment interfaces. The connector shape is only the starting point; function, pin map, power duty, cable architecture, shielding, electronics, installation and validation define the finished assembly.
intro.zh: USB 电缆组件覆盖传统 Type-A 与 Type-B、Mini 与 Micro、可翻转 Type-C、面板延长、包胶线、仅供电结构、高速数据通道以及 USB 到设备专用接口。接口外形只是起点，功能、针脚、供电负载、线缆架构、屏蔽、内部器件、安装与验证共同定义成品。

knowledge.en: A Type-C plug does not by itself establish data rate, power or video capability. Legacy USB shapes can also conceal charging-only, proprietary or converter circuits. Interface, generation, device role, internal components and test boundary must be frozen together.
knowledge.zh: Type-C 插头本身不能证明数据速率、功率或视频能力；传统 USB 外形也可能隐藏仅供电、专用针脚或转换电路。接口、代际、设备角色、内部器件和测试边界需要一起冻结。

notes.en: Provide both endpoints, mating equipment, required USB function and generation, device role, data and power duty, pin map, cable length, panel and exit direction, shielding, jacket, molding, environment, quantity and validation requirements.
notes.zh: 建议提供两端接口、对插设备、所需 USB 功能与代际、设备角色、数据与供电要求、针脚、线长、面板与出线方向、屏蔽、护套、包胶、环境、数量和验证要求。

delivery.en: Engineering freezes the interface, circuits, conductor and differential-pair structure, shield path, internal components, mechanics and labels before the first build. Continuity is followed by project-specific voltage-drop, temperature, negotiation, data-link, mechanical or environmental validation where required.
delivery.zh: 工程在首件前冻结接口、回路、导体与差分对结构、屏蔽路径、内部器件、机械结构和标识。导通之后，再按项目执行压降、温升、协商、数据链路、机械或环境验证。

intro.en: Audio cable assemblies connect microphones, instruments, mixers, amplifiers, loudspeakers, broadcast equipment and installed AV systems. XLR, TRS, TS, RCA, 3.5 mm, multipin and equipment-specific ends can carry balanced or unbalanced analog audio, digital audio, control or combined circuits; the finished cable is defined by the complete signal path, not the connector name alone.
intro.zh: 音频电缆组件用于连接麦克风、乐器、调音台、功放、扬声器、广播设备与固定式音视频系统。XLR、TRS、TS、RCA、3.5 mm、多芯及设备专用接口可承载平衡或非平衡模拟音频、数字音频、控制或复合回路；真正定义成品的是完整信号路径，而不只是接口名称。

knowledge.en: Microphone, line, instrument and speaker circuits operate at different levels and impedances. Pair geometry, conductor resistance, capacitance, shield coverage, ground strategy, connector wiring, cable length and installation environment therefore need to be reviewed together.
knowledge.zh: 麦克风、线路、乐器与扬声器回路具有不同的信号电平和阻抗。双绞结构、导体电阻、电容、屏蔽覆盖、接地策略、接口接线、线长与安装环境需要共同审核。

notes.en: Provide both equipment endpoints, connector sex and orientation, signal type and level, balanced or unbalanced wiring, pin map, channel count, length, flexibility, shield and grounding requirements, installation method, quantity and validation boundary.
notes.zh: 建议提供两端设备、接口公母与方向、信号类型和电平、平衡或非平衡接线、针脚、通道数、长度、柔软性、屏蔽与接地要求、安装方式、数量和验证边界。

delivery.en: Engineering freezes the circuit map, cable construction, shield termination, connector hardware, branch lengths, labels and strain relief before the first build. Released production is checked for continuity, shorts, polarity, shield path, dimensions, identification and workmanship, with channel or equipment-level tests added where specified.
delivery.zh: 工程在首件前冻结回路、线缆结构、屏蔽端接、接口硬件、分支长度、标识与应力消除。量产按要求检查导通、短路、极性、屏蔽路径、尺寸、标识和工艺，并在项目指定时增加通道或设备级测试。

intro.en: Video cable assemblies connect cameras, displays, switchers, recorders, control rooms, industrial panels and imaging equipment. HDMI, DisplayPort, DVI, VGA, BNC/coaxial and equipment-specific interfaces may look familiar, but bandwidth, impedance, pair geometry, shielding, cable length, power and mechanical installation determine the finished assembly.
intro.zh: 视频电缆组件用于连接摄像机、显示器、切换台、录像设备、控制室、工业面板与成像设备。HDMI、DisplayPort、DVI、VGA、BNC/同轴及设备专用接口外形可能很熟悉，但真正定义成品的是带宽、阻抗、线对几何、屏蔽、线长、供电与机械安装。

knowledge.en: A connector family does not prove a resolution, refresh rate or transmission distance. The source, sink, coding mode, cable category, conductor or optical construction, equalization and full installation path must be reviewed as one link.
knowledge.zh: 接口家族并不能单独证明分辨率、刷新率或传输距离。信号源、接收端、编码模式、线缆类别、铜缆或光缆结构、均衡方式与完整安装路径必须作为一条链路共同审核。

notes.en: Provide both devices, connector type and orientation, video protocol, target format and refresh rate, color depth or chroma requirement, audio/control channels, cable and branch lengths, installation route, bend and flex conditions, shielding or grounding constraints, quantity and validation method.
notes.zh: 建议提供两端设备、接口类型与方向、视频协议、目标格式与刷新率、色深或色度采样要求、音频/控制通道、线缆与分支长度、安装路径、弯曲与运动工况、屏蔽或接地限制、数量及验证方法。

delivery.en: Engineering freezes the interface map, cable construction, pair or coax assignment, shield termination, directionality, active components, overmold or backshell, labels and inspection limits before release. Production checks wiring, shorts, shield paths, dimensions and workmanship; agreed link or equipment tests are added where continuity alone is insufficient.
delivery.zh: 工程在放行前冻结接口映射、线缆结构、线对或同轴分配、屏蔽端接、方向性、有源器件、包胶或后壳、标识与检验限值。生产检查接线、短路、屏蔽路径、尺寸和工艺；当导通不足以证明性能时，再按约定增加链路或设备测试。

intro.en: Power cable assemblies include detachable cord sets, equipment leads, panel connections, industrial power jumpers and low-voltage DC supply cables. The finished assembly is defined by the source, load, voltage, current, grounding, connector system, conductor construction, environment and applicable market requirements—not by plug shape alone.
intro.zh: 电源线组件包括可拆卸电源线、设备引线、面板连接线、工业电源跳线和低压直流供电线。成品必须由电源端、负载端、电压、电流、接地、连接器系统、导体结构、使用环境及目标市场要求共同定义，不能只按插头外形判断。

knowledge.en: A safe power path is a coordinated system. Conductor resistance creates voltage drop and heat; contacts add localized resistance; insulation and jacket must suit voltage, temperature and environment; strain relief must keep mechanical loads away from energized terminations.
knowledge.zh: 可靠的供电路径是一套相互配合的系统。导体电阻会产生压降和热量，接触件会引入局部电阻，绝缘与护套必须适应电压、温度和环境，应力消除则要把机械载荷隔离在带电端接之外。

notes.en: Provide source and load interfaces, AC or DC, nominal and maximum voltage, continuous and peak current, grounding and polarity, cable length, ambient and conductor temperature limits, flex and routing conditions, regional destination, quantity and required compliance or validation.
notes.zh: 请提供电源端与负载端接口、交流或直流、额定及最高电压、持续与峰值电流、接地与极性、线长、环境及导体温度限制、弯曲与走线工况、销售地区、数量以及所需合规或验证。

delivery.en: Engineering releases the approved circuit, conductor and cord type, connector ratings, contact and terminal process, grounding, overmold or backshell, labels and inspection limits. Production verifies wiring, polarity, shorts, dimensions and workmanship, with earth continuity, dielectric, insulation, leakage, temperature or equipment tests added only where the project requires them.
delivery.zh: 工程放行受控回路、导体和软线类别、连接器额定值、接触件与端接工艺、接地、包胶或后壳、标识及检验限值。生产检查接线、极性、短路、尺寸和工艺，并仅在项目要求时增加接地连续性、耐压、绝缘、泄漏、温升或设备运行测试。

intro.en: Battery cable assemblies carry high DC current between batteries, starters, alternators, disconnects, fuse blocks, busbars and grounded structures. They include positive and negative leads, inter-battery links, ground straps, fused branches, charging leads and service jump connections, each engineered around the actual load and installation.
intro.zh: 电池电缆组件用于在电池、起动机、发电机、隔离开关、熔断器座、母排与接地结构之间传输大电流直流电。它覆盖正负极引线、电池间连接、接地带、带熔断分支、充电线与维修搭电线，每一种都必须围绕真实负载和安装条件设计。

knowledge.en: High-current DC exposes every milliohm. Cable resistance, crimp interfaces, bolted joints and ground returns all create voltage drop and heat, especially during starting or charging peaks. A dependable assembly therefore coordinates conductor area, strand flexibility, terminal geometry, joint preparation, protection, routing and inspection.
knowledge.zh: 在大电流直流回路中，每一个毫欧都不可忽视。电缆电阻、压接界面、螺栓连接与接地回路都会产生压降和热量，在起动或充电峰值时尤其明显。因此，可靠组件必须把导体截面积、绞线柔韧性、端子几何、接合面处理、保护、走线与检验作为整体协调。

notes.en: Provide system voltage, continuous and peak current, peak duration and repetition, cable lengths, battery and equipment interfaces, lug-hole sizes and orientations, ground points, fuse or disconnect arrangement, ambient and conductor temperature, fluids, vibration, routing, quantity and required validation.
notes.zh: 请提供系统电压、持续与峰值电流、峰值持续时间及重复频率、线长、电池与设备接口、端子孔径和方向、接地点、熔断或隔离布置、环境与导体温度、液体、振动、走线、数量及所需验证。

delivery.en: Engineering releases the circuit, conductor, lugs, boots, seals, branch protection, labels, routing dimensions and process limits. Production controls strip length, strand condition, crimp tooling and orientation, then verifies continuity, polarity, resistance, dimensions and workmanship; pull, section analysis, voltage-drop, thermal, vibration or environmental checks are added when specified.
delivery.zh: 工程放行回路、导体、线鼻、护套、密封、分支保护、标识、走线尺寸与工艺限值。生产控制剥线长度、线股状态、压接工具与方向，再检查导通、极性、电阻、尺寸和工艺；需要时增加拉力、截面分析、压降、温升、振动或环境验证。

intro.en: LED cable assemblies connect drivers, controllers, dimmers, switches, distribution points, light engines, strips and luminaires. The category includes simple two-wire power leads, multi-channel RGB or RGBW harnesses, addressable-light power-and-data assemblies, sealed outdoor branches, automotive relay harnesses and equipment-internal lighting looms.
intro.zh: LED 线缆组件用于连接驱动电源、控制器、调光器、开关、分配节点、光源模组、灯带与灯具。这一小类覆盖简单两芯供电线、多通道 RGB 或 RGBW 线束、可寻址灯光的电源与数据组件、户外密封分支、汽车继电器灯光线束及设备内部照明线束。

knowledge.en: Stable light output depends on more than a connector. Supply voltage, load current, cable length, return path, channel assignment, PWM or data behavior, connector contact resistance, polarity, sealing and heat all influence brightness, color consistency and reliability. The harness is therefore engineered as part of the complete lighting circuit.
knowledge.zh: 稳定出光不只取决于连接器。供电电压、负载电流、线长、回流路径、通道分配、PWM 或数据信号、连接器接触电阻、极性、密封与温度都会影响亮度、色彩一致性和可靠性，因此线缆必须作为完整照明回路的一部分进行设计。

notes.en: Provide the LED type and load, constant-voltage or constant-current architecture, supply and controller models, pin or channel definition, continuous and peak current, cable lengths, allowable voltage drop, dimming or data protocol, connector and mating details, indoor or outdoor environment, movement, mounting, quantity, labeling and validation requirements.
notes.zh: 请提供 LED 类型与负载、恒压或恒流架构、电源与控制器型号、针脚或通道定义、持续与峰值电流、线长、允许压降、调光或数据协议、连接器与对插件资料、室内或户外环境、运动与安装条件、数量、标识及验证要求。

delivery.en: Engineering releases the circuit map, conductor sizes, channel colors, connector keying, branches, seals, labels, routing dimensions and process limits. Production controls stripping, crimping or specified soldering, polarity and sealing, then verifies circuit, shorts, dimensions and workmanship; resistance, voltage-drop, load, thermal, flex, vibration or ingress checks are added when specified.
delivery.zh: 工程放行回路图、导体尺寸、通道颜色、连接器防错、分支、密封、标签、走线尺寸与工艺限值。生产控制剥线、压接或指定焊接、极性与密封，再检验回路、短路、尺寸和工艺；需要时增加电阻、压降、带载、温升、弯曲、振动或防护验证。

intro.en: LVDS cable assemblies carry high-speed differential data between processors, serializers, displays, cameras and control electronics. This category covers internal display looms, panel links, shielded twisted-pair assemblies and application-specific power/control branches—not one universal screen cable.
intro.zh: LVDS 电缆组件用于在处理器、串行器、显示屏、摄像头与控制电子之间传输高速差分数据。这一小类覆盖设备内部屏线、面板连接、屏蔽双绞组件及按项目定义的电源/控制分支，并不是一种通用屏线。

knowledge.en: LVDS is an electrical signaling layer rather than a complete connector or display protocol. Cable geometry, differential impedance, pair balance, termination, connector transitions and grounding must match the actual transmitter, receiver and data format.
knowledge.zh: LVDS 是电气信号层，并不等同于某一种连接器或完整显示协议。线缆几何、差分阻抗、线对平衡、端接、连接器过渡与接地必须匹配实际发送端、接收端及数据格式。

notes.en: Confirm transmitter and receiver part numbers; connector drawings and pin map; pair count and lane assignment; target differential impedance; data rate and clock; cable length and routing; power/backlight circuits; shield and ground strategy; mechanical movement; sample and validation limits.
notes.zh: 需要确认发送端与接收端型号、连接器图纸和针脚表、线对数量与通道分配、目标差分阻抗、数据速率与时钟、线长和走线、电源/背光回路、屏蔽接地策略、机械运动、样品及验证限值。

delivery.en: After interface and signal requirements are frozen, engineering reviews the interconnect stack, prepares controlled samples, verifies electrical continuity and the agreed high-speed performance, then releases drawings, BOM, tooling and inspection points for repeat production.
delivery.zh: 接口与信号要求冻结后，工程团队审核完整互连链路，制作受控样品，确认电气导通与约定的高速性能，再放行图纸、BOM、工具和检验点用于重复生产。

intro.en: RF and coaxial cable assemblies carry radio-frequency, microwave, video, timing and antenna signals through a controlled-impedance path. This category includes flexible, low-loss, miniature, semi-rigid, panel-mount and application-specific assemblies—not one universal coax lead.
intro.zh: RF 与同轴电缆组件通过受控阻抗路径传输射频、微波、视频、时钟与天线信号。这一小类覆盖柔性、低损耗、微型、半刚性、面板安装及按应用定义的组件，并不是一种通用同轴线。

knowledge.en: Coaxial performance belongs to the whole channel: conductor geometry, dielectric, shield, connector interface, termination, cable length and installed routing. Connector names alone do not define impedance, usable frequency, power, loss or environmental capability.
knowledge.zh: 同轴性能属于整条通道：导体几何、介质、屏蔽、连接器界面、终端、线长与安装路由需要一起定义。仅有连接器名称不能确定阻抗、可用频率、功率、损耗或环境能力。

notes.en: Provide both mating interfaces, standard or reverse polarity, impedance, frequency band, power and DC bias, maximum insertion loss and return-loss/VSWR target, cable length and phase requirement, shielding or PIM requirement, routing and bend radius, panel sealing, environment, quantity and agreed test method.
notes.zh: 请提供两端对接界面、标准或反极性、阻抗、频段、功率与直流偏置、最大插入损耗和回波损耗/VSWR 目标、线长与相位要求、屏蔽或 PIM 要求、走线与弯曲半径、面板密封、环境、数量及约定测试方法。

delivery.en: Engineering first freezes the channel definition and mechanical envelope, then builds controlled samples. Released production can include connector gauging, visual and dimensional inspection, continuity and the RF measurements explicitly agreed for the project; limits and fixtures are recorded with the result.
delivery.zh: 工程团队先冻结通道定义与机械包络，再制作受控样品。放行生产可包括连接器量规、外观与尺寸、导通，以及项目明确约定的 RF 测量；限值与夹具与结果一同记录。

intro.en: Aerospace project cable assemblies connect avionics, sensors, actuators, power distribution, communication equipment and ground-support interfaces. This is a project-defined family spanning aircraft, unmanned systems, test rigs and spacecraft-related equipment—not a claim that one generic harness is flight-qualified.
intro.zh: 航空航天项目电缆组件用于连接航电设备、传感器、执行器、配电、通信设备与地面保障接口。这是覆盖飞机、无人系统、试验台及航天相关设备的项目定义类别，并不表示某一种通用线束天然具备飞行资格。

knowledge.en: The assembly is governed by the released drawing and flowed-down requirements. Electrical load, signal integrity, mass, routing, derating, vibration, temperature, pressure, fluids, flammability, outgassing, shielding, workmanship and traceability can all change the construction.
knowledge.zh: 组件应以放行图纸和逐级下达的要求为准。电气负载、信号完整性、重量、走线、降额、振动、温度、压力、液体、阻燃、放气、屏蔽、工艺与追溯都可能改变其结构。

notes.en: Provide the platform and installation zone, applicable drawing and revision, mating connector part numbers, circuit and shield schedule, voltage/current/signal data, wire and component specifications, length and branch datum, mass or space limits, environmental profile, workmanship standard, prohibited processes, inspection hold points, serialization and acceptance test plan.
notes.zh: 请提供平台与安装区域、适用图纸及版本、对插件型号、回路与屏蔽表、电压/电流/信号数据、线材和器件规范、长度与分支基准、重量或空间限制、环境谱、工艺标准、禁用工艺、检验停点、序列化和验收测试计划。

delivery.en: We review aerospace-related work project by project. Materials, personnel or process approvals, special tooling, samples, qualification evidence and customer source inspection are agreed before production. Routine manufacturing capability does not replace platform approval, airworthiness approval or mission qualification.
delivery.zh: 航空航天相关工作按项目逐项审核。材料、人员或工艺批准、专用工具、样品、鉴定证据与客户源检要求需在生产前约定。常规制造能力不能替代平台批准、适航批准或任务鉴定。

intro.en: Medical equipment cable assemblies connect sensors, patient-monitoring accessories, diagnostic instruments, therapy equipment, laboratory systems and internal electronics. The category includes many electrical and mechanical constructions; suitability is defined by the device manufacturer, intended use and released specification—not by a generic ‘medical cable’ label.
intro.zh: 医疗设备电缆组件用于连接传感器、患者监护附件、诊断仪器、治疗设备、实验室系统与设备内部电子部件。该小类包含多种电气和机械结构；是否适用应由设备制造商、预期用途与放行规范共同确定，而不能仅凭“医疗线缆”这一通用名称判断。

knowledge.en: A cable can carry low-level physiological signals, digital data, power, pneumatic tubing or several functions in one hybrid assembly. Patient proximity, applied-part classification, cleaning chemistry, flexing, connector touch-proofing, EMC, leakage-current paths and service life can change the design. Relevant IEC, ISO, AAMI, UL or customer requirements must be flowed down by exact edition and scope.
knowledge.zh: 一根组件可能传输低电平生理信号、数字数据、电源、气路，或在混合结构中同时承担多种功能。患者接近程度、应用部分分类、清洁化学品、弯折、连接器防触电、EMC、漏电流路径与使用寿命都会改变设计。适用的 IEC、ISO、AAMI、UL 或客户要求必须按准确版本与范围逐项下达。

notes.en: Provide the device and intended-use description, patient-contact boundary, mating interfaces and keying, circuit and shield schedule, signal levels and bandwidth, voltage/current, cable geometry, cleaning or disinfection method, flex and pull duty, environmental limits, material restrictions, labeling, traceability, sample quantity and the approved verification plan.
notes.zh: 请提供设备与预期用途说明、患者接触边界、对插接口与防错方式、回路和屏蔽表、信号电平与带宽、电压/电流、线缆几何、清洁或消毒方法、弯折与拉力工况、环境限值、材料限制、标签、追溯、样品数量及批准的验证计划。

delivery.en: Medical-device-related projects are reviewed individually. We can build engineering samples and controlled production assemblies to the agreed file package, but device registration, biological evaluation, electrical-safety certification and clinical or regulatory approval remain the responsibility of the legal manufacturer and qualified laboratories unless separately contracted and evidenced.
delivery.zh: 医疗器械相关项目需逐项审核。我们可依据约定文件包制作工程样品与受控量产组件，但器械注册、生物学评价、电气安全认证、临床或法规批准仍由法定制造商与具备资质的实验室负责，除非另有合同和证据明确约定。

intro.en: Military-spec project cable assemblies connect power, controls, sensors, communications and mission equipment in ground, naval, airborne and deployable systems. The term describes a controlled requirement set—not a universal quality grade. Exact component part numbers, approved sources, workmanship, environment, inspection and acceptance evidence must be defined for each program.
intro.zh: 军规项目电缆组件用于连接地面、舰载、机载及可部署系统中的电源、控制、传感器、通信与任务设备。“军规”代表一套受控要求，而不是通用质量等级；每个项目都必须明确组件准确型号、批准来源、工艺、环境、检验与接收证据。

knowledge.en: A military drawing may invoke one or many specifications covering connectors, wire, contacts, accessories, identification, workmanship, environmental methods or documentation. A component that conforms to one specification does not make the complete assembly qualified. Applicability, revision, class, slash sheet, configuration and qualification status must be read together.
knowledge.zh: 军用图纸可能同时引用连接器、线材、触点、附件、标识、工艺、环境方法或文件管理等多项规范。某个元件符合一项规范，并不代表整套组件已经合格；适用范围、版本、等级、分规范、配置与鉴定状态必须结合审核。

notes.en: Provide platform and installation zone, drawing and revision, contract data requirements, exact connector and accessory PINs, approved manufacturer or QPL constraints, circuit and shield schedule, current and signal characteristics, environmental profiles, routing and support, maintenance concept, marking, traceability, lot size, source inspection and required acceptance or qualification procedures.
notes.zh: 请提供平台与安装区域、图纸及版本、合同数据要求、连接器与附件准确型号、批准制造商或 QPL 限制、回路与屏蔽表、电流和信号特性、环境谱、走线与支撑、维修方案、标识、追溯、批量、源检及所需验收或鉴定程序。

delivery.en: Military-related projects are accepted only after capability, information-control, sourcing and compliance review. We can manufacture samples and controlled production assemblies to an agreed technical data package. We do not claim that a part is military-qualified, platform-approved or listed on a QPL unless the exact product, scope and current evidence support that statement.
delivery.zh: 军规相关项目仅在完成能力、信息控制、采购来源与合规审核后承接。我们可依据约定技术数据包制作样品与受控量产组件；除非准确产品、适用范围与当前证据能够支持，否则不会宣称零件已取得军用鉴定、平台批准或列入 QPL。

intro.en: Solar cable assemblies carry DC power between PV modules, string circuits, combiner equipment, inverters and project-specific interfaces. The category includes extension leads, module leads, branch harnesses, flying leads and pre-terminated runs; voltage, current, cable family, connector identity, route and environmental exposure must be defined together.
intro.zh: 太阳能电缆组件用于在光伏组件、组串、汇流设备、逆变器及项目接口之间传输直流电力。该小类覆盖延长线、组件引线、分支线束、飞线与预端接线路；系统电压、电流、线材体系、连接器身份、走线路径和环境暴露必须一并定义。

knowledge.en: PV cable and PV connector standards address different products and scopes. IEC 62930 covers specified single-core cross-linked PV cables up to 1.5 kV DC, while IEC 62852 addresses connectors for DC photovoltaic circuits. A compliant cable or connector does not automatically make every finished assembly suitable for a particular installation; system design, compatible components, workmanship and acceptance evidence remain project inputs.
knowledge.zh: 光伏线材与光伏连接器标准分别覆盖不同产品和范围。IEC 62930 涵盖规定的 1.5 kV DC 及以下单芯交联光伏电缆，IEC 62852 则针对光伏直流回路连接器。某根线材或某个连接器符合标准，并不自动表示所有成品组件都适用于具体安装；系统设计、兼容元件、制造工艺与验收证据仍是项目输入。

notes.en: Provide the module, inverter or combiner interfaces; exact connector manufacturer and part numbers; maximum system voltage; string open-circuit voltage at the design minimum temperature; operating and fault current; conductor size and cable designation; route, length and voltage-drop target; installation zone; branch and protection arrangement; quantity; labels; packaging; and required inspection or test method.
notes.zh: 请提供组件、逆变器或汇流设备接口；连接器制造商与准确型号；最大系统电压；设计最低温度下的组串开路电压；工作及故障电流；导体截面积与线材牌号；走线、长度和压降目标；安装区域；分支与保护方案；数量；标签；包装以及所需检验或测试方法。

delivery.en: We review the released electrical architecture and component compatibility before sampling. Custom length, color, marking, branch geometry and equipment-side termination can then be frozen in a drawing and bill of materials. Certification, ingress, flame, weathering or lifetime claims are made only when the exact materials, assembly configuration and current evidence cover them.
delivery.zh: 打样前先审核已放行的电气架构与元件兼容性，再把定制长度、颜色、标识、分支几何和设备端端接冻结到图纸与物料表。只有当准确材料、组件配置与当前证据均覆盖时，才对认证、防护、阻燃、耐候或寿命作出相应声明。

intro.en: Industrial Ethernet and RJ45 cable assemblies link PLCs, remote I/O, switches, vision equipment and service ports. We build RJ45 patch leads, M12 D/X-to-RJ45 transitions, panel extensions and equipment tails to a specified pair map, shield plan, route and acceptance target.
intro.zh: 工业以太网与 RJ45 电缆组件连接 PLC、远程 I/O、工业交换机、视觉设备与维护端口。可按指定线对映射、屏蔽方案、走线路径及验收目标，制作 RJ45 引线、M12 D/X 编码转 RJ45、面板延长线和设备尾线。

knowledge.en: The link is a complete transmission path, not two identical plugs on a length of cable. Pair count and assignment, cable category, conductor construction, shield termination, connector design, installation route and agreed test limit must work together.
