An M12 D-coded interface and an M12 X-coded interface are different geometries; a transition to an 8P8C modular plug must follow the released equipment pin schedule.
knowledge.zh: 这类组件是一条完整的传输路径，不是在线材两端装上外形相同的插头。线对数量与分配、线缆等级、导体结构、屏蔽端接、连接器设计、安装路径和约定测试限值必须协同。M12 D 编码与 M12 X 编码属于不同接口几何，转接至常被称为 RJ45 的 8P8C 模块化插头时，应遵循已放行的设备针脚表。

notes.en: Send the network protocol and target data rate, exact device ports and connector part numbers, two- or four-pair requirement, pin map, cable category and length, fixed or moving route, shield and bonding plan, PoE load where relevant, oil/temperature/washdown exposure, exit direction, labels, quantity and required verification or certification limit.
notes.zh: 请提供网络协议与目标速率、设备端口及连接器准确型号、两对或四对线要求、针脚表、线缆等级与长度、固定或运动走线、屏蔽及接地方案、相关 PoE 负载、油污/温度/冲洗环境、出线方向、标签、数量，以及所需线序核查或等级认证限值。

delivery.en: We review the drawing, sample or interface schedule before selecting a cable and termination system. The approved sample should freeze both ends, pair map, length datum, shield handling, boot or overmold geometry, marking and acceptance method. Continuity and wire-map checks are not proof of a specified Ethernet channel class; performance certification requires the agreed instrument, adapters, standard and limit.
delivery.zh: 选线与确定端接体系前，先审核图纸、样品或接口表。批准样品应冻结两端接口、线对映射、长度基准、屏蔽处理、护套或包覆成型几何、标识与验收方法。导通和线序检查不能证明某一以太网信道等级；性能认证需要约定仪器、适配器、标准与限值。

intro.en: Hybrid power and data cable assemblies bring separately defined supply and data elements through one purpose-made cable structure, then split them to the specified equipment interfaces.
intro.zh: 复合动力与数据电缆组件在一款专门制造的线缆结构内布置已分别定义的供电和数据单元，再按设备接口要求进行端部分支。

knowledge.en: Core groups, conductor section, insulation, pair geometry, shielding and jacket must be checked against the exact cable data sheet. A shared sheath does not itself prove electrical separation, channel performance or motion life.
knowledge.zh: 芯线分组、导体截面、绝缘、线对几何、屏蔽和外护套须对照准确的线缆数据表审核。共护套本身不能证明电气隔离、通道性能或运动寿命。

notes.en: Provide the power and data circuit diagrams, pin maps, exact hybrid-cable reference, mating connectors, breakout lengths, route and motion profile, and project-specific acceptance limits.
notes.zh: 请提供供电与数据回路图、针脚表、准确的复合电缆型号、对插件、分支长度、布线路径与运动工况，以及项目特定验收限值。

delivery.en: We review the cable source and assembly feasibility for the project, then define sample dimensions, termination, strain relief and separate electrical and data-path checks before release.
delivery.zh: 按项目审核线材来源与组装可行性，再定义样品尺寸、端接、应力释放及供电和数据通道各自的检验项目后放行。

displayTitle.zh: 复合动力与数据电缆组件

intro.en: Switch cable assemblies join a specified switch, its contacts and an equipment-side interface as one installable unit. Pushbutton, rocker, toggle, snap-action and limit-switch leads vary by operating form, load and installation geometry.
intro.zh: 开关电缆组件把指定开关、触点与设备侧接口组合成可安装单元。按钮、摇臂、拨动、微动及限位开关引线，会随动作方式、负载与安装几何而变化。

knowledge.en: Contact logic must be read from the exact switch data sheet and approved circuit. COM, NO and NC identify different paths in the unoperated state; illuminated switches may add a separate lamp circuit. Similar housings do not prove identical terminal maps or load ratings.
knowledge.zh: 触点逻辑必须依据准确的开关数据表与已批准回路判读。COM、NO、NC 代表未动作状态下不同的路径；带灯开关还可能具有独立的指示灯回路。外壳相似不能证明端子定义或负载额定相同。

notes.en: Provide the switch part number or sample, circuit and switch-state table, load type and ratings, terminal or mating-connector details, panel cutout, cable length and exit, environment, quantity and project-specific acceptance method.
notes.zh: 请提供开关料号或样品、回路图与状态表、负载类型和额定参数、端子或对插件资料、面板开孔、线长与出线、环境、数量及项目验收方法。

delivery.en: We review switch identity, contact schedule and cable termination before building the first article. The sample can then be checked for dimensions, terminal orientation, labels and continuity in each specified switch state. Electrical correspondence is not a claim of complete-machine safety approval.
delivery.zh: 首件制作前审核开关身份、触点表和线缆端接。样品随后可按指定开关状态检查尺寸、端子方向、标识及导通。线路对应检查并不等同于整机安全批准。

intro.en: Oil and gas equipment cable assemblies connect specified sensors, valves, pumps and control interfaces where fluid exposure, routing and maintenance conditions need close review. The assembly is defined by the actual equipment and installed zone, not by an industry label alone.
intro.zh: 油气设备电缆组件连接指定传感器、阀门、泵和控制接口，需细致审核液体暴露、布线路径与维护工况。组件由实际设备及安装区域定义，不能只凭行业名称选型。

knowledge.en: Oil and chemical resistance depends on the named fluid, concentration, temperature, exposure time and cable material. Connector seals, glands and jacket transitions must be reviewed as an installed system. Hazardous-area suitability is a separate equipment and documentation question; an ordinary cable assembly or ingress label does not establish explosion-protection approval.
knowledge.zh: 耐油与耐化学性能取决于具体介质、浓度、温度、暴露时间及线材。连接器密封、格兰头和护套过渡须按安装后的整体结构审核。危险区域适用性还需独立核对设备和文件，普通线缆组件或防护等级标识不能证明取得防爆批准。

notes.en: Provide the equipment and installation-zone details, circuit and pin map, exact connectors and cable specification, fluids, temperature and mechanical exposure, sealing interface, quantity, required documents and project-specific inspection or qualification limits.
notes.zh: 请提供设备及安装区域资料、回路图与针脚表、准确连接器及线缆规格、接触介质、温度和机械工况、密封界面、数量、所需文件以及项目检验或验证限值。

delivery.en: We review the specified interfaces, materials and sourcing documents before sampling. The approved build can then be checked for dimensions, labels, termination and circuit continuity, with additional tests defined for the project. Routine inspection is not a substitute for hazardous-area equipment approval or site acceptance.
delivery.zh: 打样前审核指定接口、材料及来源文件。获认可的样品可检查尺寸、标识、端接及回路导通，并按项目定义附加试验。常规检验不能代替危险区域设备批准或现场验收。

intro.en: Automotive diagnostic and OBD harnesses connect a vehicle diagnostic link connector to scan tools, vehicle communication interfaces, data loggers, telematics devices, test fixtures and service adapters. The category includes short extensions, right-angle leads, Y splitters, legacy-vehicle adapters, DB-style interfaces, RJ45 or USB-side assemblies and custom equipment tails; connector shape alone does not define pinout, protocol, power path or intended duty.
intro.zh: 汽车诊断与 OBD 线束用于连接车辆诊断接口与诊断仪、车辆通信接口、数据记录器、车联网设备、测试工装及维修转接器。该小类覆盖短延长线、直角引线、Y 型分支、老车型转接线、DB 接口、RJ45 或 USB 设备端组件及定制设备尾线；连接器外形本身不能定义针脚、协议、供电路径或预期工况。

knowledge.en: SAE J1962 and ISO 15031-3 define requirements for the standardized diagnostic connection between the vehicle and external test equipment, including connector design, contact allocation and related electrical circuits. The standardized shell can carry different physical layers and manufacturer-discretionary circuits. A cable therefore has to preserve the released pin map, shielding, pair geometry, grounds, power handling and device-side interface rather than merely joining matching housings.
knowledge.zh: SAE J1962 与 ISO 15031-3 规定车辆与外部测试设备之间标准化诊断连接的要求，包括连接器设计、触点分配及相关电路。相同标准外壳中可能承载不同物理层和制造商自定义回路，因此线束必须保持已放行的针脚映射、屏蔽、线对结构、接地、供电能力与设备端接口，而不能只把外形匹配的壳体连在一起。

notes.en: Provide vehicle make, model, year and market; target diagnostic or data task; vehicle-side connector and access space; exact device or tool interface; released pin map and protocol; power source and current; cable length and exit direction; shielding and termination requirements; whether another device must remain connected; environmental exposure; quantity; labels; and required inspection or functional checks.
notes.zh: 请提供车辆品牌、车型、年份和市场；目标诊断或数据任务；车辆端接口及安装空间；准确设备或工具接口；已放行针脚表与协议；供电来源及电流；线长与出线方向；屏蔽和端接要求；是否需要保留另一设备同时连接；环境暴露；数量；标签以及所需检验或功能检查。

delivery.en: We can develop from a controlled drawing, verified sample, connector part numbers or an approved interface schedule. Before sampling, the vehicle-side and device-side identities, power routing, signal conductors, grounds, shields, branch behavior and mechanical envelope are frozen. Continuity proves wiring correspondence only; protocol communication, programming suitability, gateway access and vehicle compatibility require the agreed equipment and test method.
delivery.zh: 可依据受控图纸、已验证样品、连接器型号或批准的接口表进行开发。打样前冻结车辆端与设备端身份、供电路径、信号导体、接地、屏蔽、分支行为及机械边界。导通只能证明线路对应；协议通信、编程适用性、网关访问和整车兼容性仍需约定设备与测试方法验证。

intro.en: ECU and DCU service harnesses provide controlled access between electronic control units, domain or distribution controllers, vehicle networks, power supplies, sensors, actuators, bench fixtures and diagnostic equipment. The category covers repair pigtails, breakout harnesses, Y interfaces, programming leads, controller adapters, test looms and project-specific replacement assemblies.
intro.zh: ECU 与 DCU 维修线束用于在电子控制单元、域控制器或配电控制器、车载网络、电源、传感器、执行器、台架工装与诊断设备之间建立受控连接。该小类覆盖维修尾线、测试引出线束、Y 型接口、编程引线、控制器转接线、台架测试线束及项目专用替换组件。

knowledge.en: An ECU or DCU connector can combine battery and ignition feeds, grounds, regulated sensor supplies, analogue and digital inputs, low-side or high-side outputs, communication buses, shields and reserved circuits. Connector identity is only the first layer. The released harness has to preserve cavity numbering, terminal system, wire size, pair geometry, splice topology, protection, sealing, branch location and the electrical limits of every connected load.
knowledge.zh: 一个 ECU 或 DCU 连接器可能同时包含蓄电池与点火供电、接地、稳压传感器电源、模拟与数字输入、高边或低边输出、通信总线、屏蔽及预留回路。连接器身份只是第一层；放行线束还必须保持孔位编号、端子体系、线径、线对结构、接续拓扑、保护、密封、分支位置以及每个连接负载的电气限值。

notes.en: Provide controller manufacturer and exact part number; vehicle or equipment platform and model year; connector housings, terminals, seals and backshells; mating-face views; released pin schedule; supply voltage and load current; network type; sensors and actuators; branch and splice drawing; installation zone; length datums; protection; quantity; labels; and the required bench, vehicle or environmental validation.
notes.zh: 请提供控制器制造商与准确型号；车辆或设备平台及年份；连接器壳体、端子、密封与尾壳；对插面视图；已放行针脚表；供电电压和负载电流；网络类型；传感器与执行器；分支和接续图；安装区域；长度基准；保护方案；数量；标签以及所需台架、实车或环境验证。

delivery.en: We translate approved interface data into a controlled drawing, bill of materials, circuit table and test program. Samples are checked for connector fit, keying, wire and seal compatibility, pin mapping, dimensions and the agreed electrical functions before repeat production. Vehicle function, calibration, programming and safety behavior remain system-level responsibilities unless the exact equipment and validation scope are included.
delivery.zh: 我们把批准的接口资料转化为受控图纸、物料表、回路表与测试程序。样品在重复生产前核对连接器匹配、防错、线材与密封相容、针脚映射、尺寸及约定电气功能。整车功能、标定、编程与安全行为仍属于系统层责任，除非项目明确包含准确设备与验证范围。

intro.en: J1939 heavy-duty harnesses connect service tools, telematics devices, data loggers, displays, gateways and vehicle controllers to the communication and power interfaces used across trucks, buses, trailers, construction machines, agricultural equipment and vehicle-derived stationary systems.
intro.zh: J1939 重卡线束用于把维修工具、车联网设备、数据记录器、显示终端、网关和车辆控制器连接到卡车、客车、挂车、工程机械、农业设备及车辆衍生固定设备的通信与供电接口。

knowledge.en: J1939 is a family of SAE documents for heavy-duty vehicle networking, not the name of one universal cable. A released assembly must identify the applicable connector, keying, populated cavities, network channel, bit rate, power path, shielding or twisted-pair construction, topology, device-side interface and operating environment.
knowledge.zh: J1939 是面向重型车辆网络的一组 SAE 文件体系，而不是某一种通用线缆的名称。可放行组件必须明确适用连接器、防错键位、已装孔位、网络通道、速率、供电路径、屏蔽或双绞结构、拓扑、设备端接口及使用环境。

notes.en: Provide the vehicle or equipment maker, model and year; engine and controller identifiers; connector color and mating-face photographs; released pin map; required network channel and speed; tool or device interface; whether the lead is for diagnostics, logging, telematics or permanent installation; cable length and branch datums; sealing, abrasion, temperature and chemical exposure; quantity; labels; and the required electrical and communication checks.
notes.zh: 请提供车辆或设备制造商、型号与年份；发动机及控制器信息；连接器颜色和对插面照片；已批准针脚表；所需网络通道与速率；工具或设备端接口；诊断、记录、车联网或永久安装用途；线长与分支基准；密封、磨损、温度及化学暴露；数量、标签以及所需电气和通信检查。

delivery.en: We convert approved interface and network information into controlled drawings, connector and terminal BOMs, cable definitions, branch dimensions, molding or backshell requirements, identification and test programs. Production checks can verify construction and pin mapping; live J1939 communication requires the specified vehicle, controller, simulator or approved network fixture and an agreed functional scope.
delivery.zh: 我们把批准的接口和网络资料转化为受控图纸、连接器与端子物料表、线缆定义、分支尺寸、包胶或尾壳要求、标识与测试程序。生产检查可以核实结构和针脚映射；实际 J1939 通信仍需指定车辆、控制器、模拟器或批准的网络工装，并明确功能验证范围。

intro.en: Truck harnesses distribute power, ground, lighting, control and network circuits through the cab, powertrain, chassis and rear equipment of light-, medium- and heavy-duty commercial vehicles. The category covers complete vehicle looms as well as cab, chassis, engine, transmission, lighting, power-distribution, body-builder and trailer-interface sub-harnesses.
intro.zh: 卡车线束把电源、接地、照明、控制与网络回路分配到轻型、中型及重型商用车的驾驶室、动力总成、底盘和车尾设备。该小类既覆盖整车主线束，也覆盖驾驶室、底盘、发动机、变速器、照明、配电、上装及挂车接口等分线束。

knowledge.en: A truck harness is a vehicle architecture rather than a generic bundle of wires. Cab and chassis zones have different exposure, service access and mechanical movement. Every released branch therefore links circuit function, load, protection, connector system, route, support spacing, bend allowance, splice position, environmental zone and validation method.
knowledge.zh: 卡车线束是一套车辆电气架构，而不是通用导线的捆扎。驾驶室与底盘区域的暴露、维修可达性和机械运动各不相同，因此每条放行支路都要关联回路功能、负载、保护、连接器体系、路径、固定间距、弯曲余量、接续位置、环境分区与验证方法。

notes.en: Provide vehicle maker, platform, model year and cab or wheelbase configuration; system voltage; equipment and controller part numbers; circuit and pin tables; load current and protection; connector BOM; zone and routing photographs; branch datums; clips, grommets and coverings; articulation or service loops; body-builder and trailer interfaces; labels; quantity; and the required electrical, mechanical or environmental checks.
notes.zh: 请提供车辆制造商、平台、年份及驾驶室或轴距配置；系统电压；设备与控制器型号；回路与针脚表；负载电流及保护；连接器物料表；分区和走线照片；分支基准；卡扣、护圈与覆盖层；铰接或维修余量；上装与挂车接口；标签、数量以及所需电气、机械或环境检查。

delivery.en: We convert approved vehicle information into controlled drawings, circuit schedules, connector and terminal BOMs, splice maps, route dimensions, covering instructions, labels and test programs. Sample fit is reviewed on the specified vehicle or fixture before repeat production. Continuity and workmanship checks confirm the manufactured harness; complete vehicle behavior remains a system-level validation unless the exact vehicle, loads and acceptance plan are included.
delivery.zh: 我们把批准的车辆资料转化为受控图纸、回路表、连接器与端子物料表、接续图、走线尺寸、覆盖工艺、标签及测试程序。重复生产前在指定车辆或工装上审核样品装配；导通与工艺检查确认线束制造结果，完整整车行为仍属于系统级验证，除非项目明确包含准确车辆、负载与验收计划。

intro.en: Construction vehicle harnesses distribute power, control, sensor and communication circuits across excavators, loaders, cranes, bulldozers, graders, compactors, aerial platforms and other self-propelled work machines. The category includes complete machine looms and cab, engine, chassis, boom, hydraulic-control, lighting and attachment sub-harnesses.
intro.zh: 工程车辆线束为挖掘机、装载机、起重机、推土机、平地机、压路机、高空作业平台及其他自行式作业机械分配电源、控制、传感与通信回路。该小类覆盖整机主线束以及驾驶室、发动机、底盘、臂架、液压控制、照明与属具分线束。

knowledge.en: Off-road machines combine mobile-vehicle wiring with industrial actuators, hydraulic systems and exposed articulation. Harness design must follow the actual machine zone, movement envelope, duty cycle and service method. Connector sealing alone cannot compensate for poor routing, unsupported mass, trapped water, excessive branch stiffness or the wrong terminal and wire-seal combination.
knowledge.zh: 非道路机械把移动车辆布线、工业执行器、液压系统与裸露铰接结构结合在一起。线束设计必须服从实际机器分区、运动包络、工作循环与维修方式；单靠连接器密封无法弥补错误走线、无支撑重量、积水、分支过硬或端子与线封组合不匹配。

notes.en: Provide machine maker, model and serial range; equipment type and installed attachments; voltage architecture; controller, valve, sensor and actuator data; drawings, samples and mating interfaces; circuit and network definitions; boom, articulation and service movement; heat, dust, mud, washdown, oil and chemical zones; clips, brackets and pass-throughs; branch datums; labels; quantity; and validation requirements.
notes.zh: 请提供机器制造商、型号与序列号范围；设备类型及安装属具；电压架构；控制器、阀、传感器与执行器资料；图纸、样品及对插件；回路与网络定义；臂架、铰接与维修运动；高温、粉尘、泥浆、冲洗、油液与化学分区；卡扣、支架与穿孔；分支基准、标签、数量及验证要求。

delivery.en: Approved requirements are converted into controlled drawings, circuit lists, BOMs, splice maps, form-board datums, protection instructions, labels and test programs. First articles are checked on the target machine or representative fixture for reach, movement, clearance, connector access and agreed function before repeat production. Evidence is released by machine configuration and drawing revision.
delivery.zh: 批准需求会被转化为受控图纸、回路表、物料表、接续图、布线板基准、防护工艺、标签与测试程序。重复生产前在目标机器或代表性工装上检查首件的可达、运动、间隙、接口访问及约定功能；证据按机器配置与图纸版本放行。

intro.en: Trailer harnesses connect the towing vehicle with semi-trailers, utility trailers, equipment carriers, dump trailers, campers, boat trailers and agricultural trailers. The category includes front interface leads, complete chassis looms, lighting branches, brake and ABS/EBS circuits, axle leads, breakaway and battery circuits, liftgate or hydraulic power branches, reefer connections and rear-door assemblies.
intro.zh: 拖车线束连接牵引车与半挂车、通用拖车、设备运输拖车、自卸拖车、露营拖车、船用拖车及农业拖车。该小类覆盖前端连接线、完整底盘主线束、灯光分支、制动与 ABS/EBS 回路、车轴引线、脱离制动与蓄电池回路、尾板或液压动力分支、冷藏机组连接及后门组件。

knowledge.en: A trailer harness is not one universal cable. Connector family, regional interface, system voltage, circuit count, trailer length, axle and brake architecture, installed equipment and exposure determine the released design. A plug that mates mechanically does not prove pin assignment, current capacity, grounding, network compatibility or environmental performance.
knowledge.zh: 拖车线束不是一根通用电缆。连接器家族、地区接口、系统电压、回路数量、拖车长度、车轴与制动架构、安装设备及暴露环境共同决定放行设计。插头能够机械插合，并不能证明针脚定义、载流能力、接地、网络兼容性或环境性能。

notes.en: Provide towing vehicle and trailer type; market and applicable interface standard; system voltage; connector and mating-part data; circuit table and loads; lighting, brake, ABS/EBS and auxiliary equipment; trailer length, axle count and articulation points; chassis route photographs; clips and pass-throughs; water, salt, mud, UV and washdown exposure; drawings or sample; labels; quantity; and required validation.
notes.zh: 请提供牵引车与拖车类型、销售市场及适用接口标准、系统电压、连接器与对插件资料、回路表与负载、灯光、制动、ABS/EBS 及辅助设备信息、拖车长度、车轴数量与铰接点、底盘走线照片、卡扣与穿孔、水、盐、泥浆、紫外线及冲洗暴露、图纸或样品、标签、数量与所需验证。

delivery.en: Approved requirements become controlled drawings, circuit and pin tables, BOMs, cut lists, splice maps, route datums, protection instructions, labels and test programs. First articles are checked for mating, reach, articulation, chassis clearance, lamp and equipment function and agreed vehicle behavior before repeat production. Records remain linked to trailer configuration and drawing revision.
delivery.zh: 批准需求会转化为受控图纸、回路与针脚表、物料表、裁线表、接续图、走线基准、防护工艺、标签与测试程序。重复生产前检查首件的对插、可达、铰接、底盘间隙、灯具与设备功能及约定车辆行为，记录持续关联拖车配置和图纸版本。

intro.en: Vehicle lighting harnesses distribute protected power, grounds and control signals to headlamps, daytime running lamps, fog lamps, front and rear combination lamps, side markers, licence lamps, interior lamps, work lamps and illuminated accessories. The category includes lamp pigtails, front-end and rear-body sub-harnesses, relay-and-fuse looms, LED driver leads, tailgate and door branches, test adapters and complete lighting kits.
intro.zh: 汽车灯线束向前照灯、日间行车灯、雾灯、前后组合灯、侧标志灯、牌照灯、车内灯、工作灯与发光附件分配受保护的电源、接地和控制信号。该小类覆盖灯具尾线、前端与后车身分线束、继电器保险线束、LED 驱动引线、尾门与车门分支、测试转接线及完整灯光套件。

knowledge.en: A lighting harness is not defined by a bulb socket alone. Lamp technology, optical function, circuit current, switching method, body controller, diagnostics, connector keying, route, thermal zone, sealing and destination-market requirements determine the released assembly. A connector that fits can still have the wrong pinout, ground strategy, load capacity or control architecture.
knowledge.zh: 汽车灯线束不能只凭灯泡插座定义。灯具技术、光学功能、回路电流、开关方式、车身控制器、诊断、连接器防错、走线、热区、密封与目标市场要求共同决定放行组件。连接器即使能插合，也可能存在针脚、接地策略、负载能力或控制架构错误。

notes.en: Provide vehicle or equipment identity; model year and market; lamp positions and technologies; lamp, bulb, driver and mating-connector data; system voltage; circuit and pin tables; continuous, inrush and fault current; fuse, relay, BCM, PWM or LIN control; ground strategy; route and branch datums; temperature, water, salt, vibration and flex exposure; drawings or samples; labels; quantity; and required validation.
notes.zh: 请提供车辆或设备身份、年款与市场、灯位与灯具技术、灯具、灯泡、驱动器和对插件资料、系统电压、回路与针脚表、持续、冲击与故障电流、保险、继电器、BCM、PWM 或 LIN 控制、接地策略、走线与分支基准、温度、水、盐、振动及弯折暴露、图纸或样品、标签、数量与所需验证。

delivery.en: Approved requirements become controlled drawings, pin and circuit tables, BOMs, cut lists, splice maps, branch datums, protection instructions, labels and test definitions. First articles are checked for mating, reach, lamp installation, current path, voltage drop and agreed functions before repeat production. Harness, lamp, vehicle configuration, fixture and inspection records remain linked by revision.
delivery.zh: 批准需求会转化为受控图纸、针脚与回路表、物料表、裁线表、接续图、分支基准、防护工艺、标签与测试定义。重复生产前检查首件的对插、可达、灯具装配、电流路径、压降与约定功能，线束、灯具、车辆配置、工装及检验记录按版本保持关联。

intro.en: Engine harnesses connect the ECU, protected power distribution, sensors, injectors, ignition components, throttle and air controls, pumps, valves, aftertreatment devices and the vehicle-side interface around the power unit. The category includes compact on-engine looms, engine-bay sub-harnesses, injector and ignition branches, sensor leads, transmission and aftertreatment branches, generator-set harnesses and complete engine-to-body assemblies.
intro.zh: 发动机线束连接 ECU、受保护配电、传感器、喷油器、点火部件、节气门与进气控制、泵、阀、后处理设备以及动力单元周边的车身侧接口。该小类覆盖紧凑型发动机本体线束、发动机舱分线束、喷油与点火分支、传感器引线、变速箱与后处理分支、发电机组线束及完整发动机到车身组件。

knowledge.en: An engine harness is a coordinated power, signal, communication and mechanical routing system, not a bundle copied from connector appearance. Engine family, controller, sensor and actuator set, firing order, transmission, emissions equipment, system voltage, thermal map, vibration, fluids, service route and vehicle interface determine the released design.
knowledge.zh: 发动机线束是一套协调供电、信号、通信与机械走线的系统，不能依据连接器外观简单复制。发动机家族、控制器、传感器与执行器组合、点火顺序、变速箱、排放设备、系统电压、热分布、振动、油液、维修路径和整车接口共同决定放行设计。

notes.en: Provide engine and vehicle or equipment identity; controller and calibration family; system voltage; connector and mating-part data; pin and circuit tables; sensor, injector, ignition, valve, motor and heater loads; CAN, LIN or other communication details; grounding and shielding intent; on-engine and body-side breakpoints; route photographs and datums; heat, vibration, oil, fuel, coolant, water and abrasion exposure; drawings or sample; labels; quantity; and required validation.
notes.zh: 请提供发动机及车辆或设备身份、控制器与标定家族、系统电压、连接器及对插件资料、针脚与回路表、传感器、喷油器、点火、阀、电机与加热器负载、CAN、LIN 或其他通信信息、接地与屏蔽意图、发动机本体和车身侧断开点、走线照片与基准、热、振动、机油、燃油、冷却液、水与磨损暴露、图纸或样品、标签、数量及所需验证。

delivery.en: Approved requirements become controlled drawings, pin and circuit tables, BOMs, cut lists, splice maps, branch datums, shielding and protection instructions, labels and test definitions. First articles are checked for mating, reach, clip position, engine installation, service access, electrical identity and agreed powered functions before repeat production. Harness revision remains linked to engine, controller, vehicle configuration, fixture and inspection records.
delivery.zh: 批准需求会转化为受控图纸、针脚与回路表、物料表、裁线表、接续图、分支基准、屏蔽与防护工艺、标签及测试定义。重复生产前检查首件的对插、可达、卡扣位置、发动机装配、维修空间、电气身份与约定上电功能；线束版本持续关联发动机、控制器、车辆配置、工装和检验记录。

intro.en: Agricultural and tractor wiring harnesses cover cab controls, engine and chassis circuits, lighting, sensors, implements and field-service connections. We develop each main loom or replaceable branch from the actual machine, interface schedule and working environment—not a generic tractor outline.
intro.zh: 农机与拖拉机线束覆盖驾驶室控制、发动机与底盘回路、照明、传感器、农具以及田间维修接口。主线束或可更换分支均依据具体机型、接口表和作业环境开发，不按一张通用拖拉机轮廓图生产。

knowledge.en: A tractor harness is a family of zone-specific assemblies rather than one universal part. Cab, powertrain, chassis and implement branches face different vibration, mud, spray, UV, temperature and service loads. An ISOBUS-shaped connector alone does not establish ISO 11783 communication or AEF function compatibility; controller software, bus topology, power supply and implement functions must also match.
knowledge.zh: 拖拉机线束是由多个区域组件构成的产品家族，不是一种通用零件。驾驶室、动力总成、底盘与农具分支面对的振动、泥水、喷淋、紫外线、温度和维修载荷不同。只有 ISOBUS 外形的接头并不能证明 ISO 11783 通信或 AEF 功能兼容；控制器软件、总线拓扑、供电和农具功能也必须匹配。

notes.en: For quotation, provide machine make, model and revision, voltage, circuit and pin schedules, mating connector part numbers, loads and fusing, CAN/ISOBUS topology if used, branch lengths and installation photographs, movement and exposure zones, quantity, labels and the agreed inspection scope. A reference sample helps establish geometry, but undocumented repairs must be distinguished from the intended design.
notes.zh: 报价请提供设备品牌、型号与版本、电压、回路和针脚表、对插连接器料号、负载与保险配置、涉及的 CAN/ISOBUS 拓扑、分支尺寸和安装照片、运动与暴露区域、数量、标签及约定检验范围。参考样品有助于确定几何，但应把未记录的维修痕迹与原设计区分。

delivery.en: The approved drawing and first article freeze connector orientation, cavity map, branch datum, covering transitions, clips, service loops and test points. Routine continuity, shorts, dimensional and visual checks are recorded to the agreed plan. Sealing, vibration, flex, thermal and full-machine functional validation are separate project-defined tests; they are not implied by a passing wire map.
delivery.zh: 经批准的图纸与首件应冻结连接器方向、孔位映射、分支基准、包覆过渡、卡扣、检修余量及测试点。常规导通、短路、尺寸和外观检查按约定方案记录；密封、振动、弯曲、热和整机功能验证属于另行定义的项目测试，不能由线序合格推定。

intro.en: Fuel-system harnesses connect controllers with pump modules, injectors, pressure and temperature sensors, metering valves and related devices. Custom options include tank-module leads, pump branches, gasoline or diesel injector looms, sensor pigtails and repair assemblies. These are electrical components, not fuel hoses or pressure pipes.
intro.zh: 燃油系统线束在车辆控制器、燃油泵模块、喷油器、压力与温度传感器、计量阀及相关接口之间传送电源与控制信号。这个定制小类包括油箱模块引线、外置泵分支、汽油喷油器线束、柴油共轨分支、传感器短引线和维修组件。它是电气布线，不是输送燃油的软管或承压管路。

knowledge.en: Fuel delivery architectures differ across port-injected gasoline, gasoline direct injection and diesel common rail. A matching connector body does not establish the correct pin map, injector driver, pump current, sensor reference or environmental rating. Define each circuit and its installed zone before choosing wire, terminals, sealing and branch protection.
knowledge.zh: 歧管喷射汽油机、汽油直喷和柴油共轨的供油电气架构并不相同。接头外壳能对插，不代表针脚表、喷油驱动、泵电流、传感器参考电压或环境等级正确。选择线材、端子、密封与分支防护前，先定义每条回路及其安装区域。

notes.en: Send vehicle and engine identity, controller family, system voltage, pump and injector part numbers, mating connectors and cavity views, circuit and pin tables, sensor outputs, route dimensions, clips, heat and fuel exposure, sample or drawing, quantity and agreed inspection requirements.
notes.zh: 请提供车辆与发动机身份、控制器家族、系统电压、泵和喷油器料号、对插件与孔位视图、回路及针脚表、传感器输出形式、走线尺寸、卡扣、热与燃油暴露条件、样品或图纸、数量和约定检验要求。

delivery.en: Approved inputs become controlled drawings, a pin and circuit map, BOM, branch datums, termination and protection instructions, labels and inspection criteria. A first article is reviewed for mating, reach, routing and electrical identity before repeat build; powered function, ingress, thermal and chemical tests require separately agreed methods and limits.
delivery.zh: 批准的输入转化为受控图纸、针脚与回路图、物料表、分支基准、端接和防护工艺、标签及检验准则。重复制作前，首件核对对插、可达、走线和电气身份；上电功能、防护、热与化学测试须另行约定方法和限值。

intro.en: Dashboard and instrument-cluster harnesses link the cluster, cockpit switches, HVAC controls, display, body controller and junctions specified for a vehicle. We build full cross-car looms, cluster jumpers, center-console branches and repair pigtails. Each version follows an approved pin map, installation route and service boundary—not a universal dashboard plug.
intro.zh: 仪表台与仪表盘线束按具体车型连接组合仪表、座舱开关、空调控制、显示或主机、车身控制器及配电接口。可定制横跨仪表台的总线束、仪表盘短引线、中控分支、开关尾线或受控替换件。每一款都要按车辆变型、针脚表、安装路径和维修边界定义，不能只凭所谓通用仪表插头判断。

knowledge.en: The visible display is only one endpoint of a vehicle electrical architecture. Power, grounds, illumination, CAN or LIN and sometimes other data links may reach the cluster through dedicated connectors; exact circuits vary by platform. A fit-matching shell does not prove correct signals, software configuration, warning telltales or safety function.
knowledge.zh: 可见的显示界面只是整车电气架构的一个端点。电源、接地、照明、CAN 或 LIN，以及其他数据链路可能通过专用接口到达组合仪表；具体回路随平台改变。壳体能对插，不证明信号、软件配置、警示灯或安全功能正确。

notes.en: Send the vehicle/platform and model year, variant or trim, right- or left-hand-drive layout, circuit and cavity tables, mating connector part numbers, cluster and controller references, route drawings or sample, mounting clips, branch datums, expected quantities and agreed inspection points. Identify any SRS or other safety-critical interfaces separately.
notes.zh: 请提供车型平台与年款、配置变型、左右舵布局、回路与孔位表、对插件料号、仪表与控制器资料、走线图或样品、卡扣、分支基准、预计数量和约定检验项；涉及 SRS 等安全关键接口须单独标识。

delivery.en: Approved information becomes a controlled drawing, connector and pin matrix, BOM, branch geometry, labels and inspection plan. First-article review checks mating, reach, terminal seating, clip positions, clearance and circuit identity. Continuity or short testing does not certify the cluster's displayed functions, SRS performance or vehicle-level behavior; those need separate OEM-led validation.
delivery.zh: 批准资料转化为受控图纸、连接器与针脚矩阵、物料表、分支几何、标签和检验计划。首件核对对插、可达、端子入位、卡扣位置、间隙及回路身份。导通或短路测试不代表仪表显示功能、SRS 性能或整车行为已验证；这些需要另行按整车方要求验证。

intro.en: Transmission harnesses carry power, commands and feedback between a transmission control unit, mechatronic assembly, solenoids, speed or position sensors, range selector and the vehicle-side loom. The category includes external gearbox leads, sealed through-case interfaces and, where specified, oil-wet internal branches. The correct assembly depends on the exact transmission and vehicle variant, not a generic gearbox plug.
intro.zh: 变速箱线束在变速箱控制单元、机电液模块、电磁阀、转速或位置传感器、挡位选择器与整车线束之间传输电源、指令和反馈。本小类包括箱体外部引线、穿壳密封接口，以及按项目要求制作的油浸式内部支路。正确的组件取决于准确的变速箱和车型变型，不能按所谓通用变速箱插头确定。

knowledge.en: A transmission controller interprets sensor signals and drives the relevant actuators; it may be integrated into a module, attached to the transmission or housed separately. A harness therefore needs a controlled pin map and an explicit boundary between oil-wet, through-wall and vehicle-side environments. Matching connector shape alone does not establish signal identity, fluid compatibility or leak tightness.
knowledge.zh: 变速箱控制单元读取传感器信号并驱动相应执行器；它可能集成在模块中、安装于变速箱上，也可能独立布置。因此线束必须有受控针脚表，并明确油浸区、穿壳区和整车外侧环境的边界。接头外形相同不能证明信号身份、油液相容性或密封可靠性。

notes.en: For quotation, identify vehicle and transmission model, model year and variant, TCU or mechatronic reference, internal or external scope, connector part numbers and cavity views, solenoid and sensor assignments, operating voltage, route and clip datums, specified fluid and temperature exposure, drawings or an approved sample, quantities and the required inspection plan. Oil-wet or safety-related scope needs separate review.
notes.zh: 询价请提供车型、变速箱型号、年款与变型、TCU 或机电液模块料号、内部或外部供货范围、连接器料号与孔位视图、电磁阀和传感器回路、电压、走线与固定基准、指定油液和温度暴露、图纸或批准样品、数量及所需检验计划。油浸或安全相关范围须单独审核。

delivery.en: Approved inputs become a circuit matrix, connector BOM, branch drawing, material record and first-article inspection plan. Checks can include cavity and wire identity, terminal seating, locks, branch dimensions, connector mating and agreed electrical tests. Fluid resistance, seal integrity, controller behavior and vehicle shift performance require their own specified methods and acceptance criteria; continuity alone does not establish them.
delivery.zh: 批准资料转化为回路矩阵、连接器物料表、分支图、材料记录与首件检验计划。可核对孔位与线号、端子入位、锁止、分支尺寸、对插及约定电气项目。耐油、密封、控制器行为和整车换挡性能均需各自规定试验方法与接收标准，不能由导通合格推导。

intro.en: Custom Anderson interface cable projects for Powerpole, SB and specified battery-power connectors. We define the exact housing, contact, keying, polarity, conductor, termination and installation duty before making a cable, jumper, charger lead or equipment pigtail.
intro.zh: 按指定 Anderson 接口制作 Powerpole、SB 等电源连接电缆项目。无论是电池引线、充电线、设备尾线还是转接组件，先确定壳体、触点、防误插、极性、导体、端接与实际工况，再定义线缆。

knowledge.en: Powerpole modular housings and two-pole SB housings are different connection systems. A family name alone does not establish mating fit, current rating or polarity. Contact part number, cable cross-section, temperature rise, assembly method and the manufacturer's series-specific documentation all matter.
knowledge.zh: 模块化 Powerpole 与双极 SB 属于不同连接体系。仅凭系列名称不能认定可对插、电流额定值或极性。触点料号、线径、温升、装配方法及制造商对应系列资料都必须纳入审核。

notes.en: Supply the manufacturer and complete connector series or part number, mating-side photograph and contact view, circuit and polarity drawing, continuous and peak load, voltage, wire size and cable length, opposite-end interface, installation environment, quantity and acceptance criteria. Identify auxiliary contacts or battery-monitoring circuits separately.
notes.zh: 请提供制造商及完整接口系列／料号、对插侧照片与触点视图、回路和极性图、连续与峰值负载、电压、线径与长度、另一端接口、安装环境、数量和接收标准。辅助触点或电池监测回路须单独标明。

delivery.en: The approved inputs become a controlled connector-and-contact BOM, cable drawing, polarity map, assembly instructions and first-article checklist. The inspection scope can cover wire identity, crimp geometry, contact retention, housing keying, cable length and agreed electrical checks. Continuity alone cannot prove rated-load temperature, charging-system compatibility or equipment safety.
delivery.zh: 批准资料将转成受控的壳体与触点物料表、线缆图、极性表、装配指引和首件核对清单。检验范围可包括线号、压接几何、触点保持、壳体防错、长度及约定电气项目。导通合格不能单独证明额定负载温升、充电系统兼容或设备安全。

intro.zh: 围绕指定 HARTING Han 系列接口制作可拆卸机台、控制柜与设备模块连接电缆。以完整料号、对插件、回路图和安装环境定义组件；名称相近的外壳、插芯与触点不能未经核对直接互换。
intro.en: Cable assemblies built around a specified HARTING Han interface for removable machines, control cabinets and equipment modules. The complete part references, mating half, circuit drawing and installation duty define the assembly; similarly named hoods, inserts and contacts are not automatically interchangeable.

knowledge.zh: Han 是矩形工业连接器家族，不是一种固定针位的插头。选型可能涉及外壳、底座、单体插芯或 Han-Modular 框架、功率／信号／数据模块、触点、锁扣与进线件。实际电气和环境能力取决于所选整套部件及其装配条件。
knowledge.en: Han is a family of rectangular industrial connectors, not one fixed pinout. A configuration may include hood, housing, monobloc insert or Han-Modular frame, power/signal/data modules, contacts, latches and cable entry. Electrical and environmental performance belongs to the specified complete assembly and its installation conditions.

notes.zh: 询价请提供 Han 系列与外壳尺寸、每个外壳／底座／插芯或模块／触点的料号、对插面视图、针脚与回路表、负载与电压、导体和护套、出线方向、格兰头与锁扣形式、安装环境、数量及验收要求。品牌兼容不代表 HARTING 授权或认证。
notes.en: For quotation, provide the Han series and housing size; part numbers for each hood, base, insert or module and contact; mating-face view, pin and circuit map, load and voltage, conductors and jacket, cable-exit direction, gland and latch choice, environment, quantity and acceptance criteria. Compatible work does not imply HARTING authorization or certification.

delivery.zh: 经客户确认后形成受控物料表、回路图、端接与装配指引、首件核对点和约定检验项目。重点核对插芯朝向、接点位置、触点入位、锁扣闭合、进线夹持、线长与导通；IP、防振或额定负载表现须按准确产品资料与项目试验单独证明。
delivery.en: Approved inputs become a controlled BOM, circuit drawing, termination and assembly instructions, first-article checkpoints and agreed inspections. Check insert orientation, contact position and seating, latch closure, cable-entry retention, length and continuity. IP, vibration or rated-load performance requires the exact product data and separately defined project evidence.

intro.zh: 围绕客户指定的 Conxall 系列接口制作定制电缆组件。核对 Micro-Con-X、Mini-Con-X、Multi-Con-X 或屏蔽型的准确料号、触点排列、对插件与安装状态，再定义线材、端接、分支和检验方案。
intro.en: Custom cable assemblies for customer-specified Conxall-family interfaces. We verify exact Micro-Con-X, Mini-Con-X, Multi-Con-X or shielded part numbers, contact arrangements, mating halves and installation conditions before defining cable, termination, branches and inspection.

intro.zh: 围绕客户指定的矢崎 Yazaki 连接器，制作传感器引线、车身分支、设备转接与可拆卸线束。先核对准确壳体、端子、线封、二次锁及对插件，再决定针脚、线材和安装走向；系列名称本身不能代替完整配置。
intro.en: Sensor leads, vehicle branches, equipment adapters and removable harnesses built around customer-specified Yazaki connectors. We verify the exact housing, terminal, wire seal, secondary lock and mating half before defining pins, cable and routing; a family name is not a complete configuration.

knowledge.zh: 矢崎汽车连接器目录同时包含防水与非防水、线对线与设备端等不同结构。YESC、YMT 1.2、0.64（025）、1.5（060）、2.3（090）等名称有助于定位系列，但极数、防错编码、端子尺寸与密封方式仍须落实到料号和图纸。
knowledge.en: Yazaki's automotive connector catalog spans sealed and unsealed, wire-to-wire and device-side structures. Names such as YESC, YMT 1.2, 0.64 (025), 1.5 (060) and 2.3 (090) help locate a family, but cavity count, keying, terminal size and sealing must still be resolved by part number and drawing.

notes.zh: 询价请提供两侧壳体与对插件料号、正视针脚图、端子和线封、回路表、导体规格、环境与温度、固定点、分支尺寸、数量和验收要求。照片和旧样可辅助识别，却不能证明不可见的电气功能或替代料获准。
notes.en: For quotation, provide housing and mating part numbers, mating-face pin views, terminals and seals, circuit map, conductors, environment and temperature, fixing points, branch dimensions, quantity and acceptance criteria. Photos or an old sample aid identification but do not authorize unseen electrical functions or substitute parts.

delivery.zh: 批准后的配置转化为受控 BOM、针脚表、加工与首件检查点。核查压接、端子保持、线封位置、二次锁、支路尺寸、导通与对插；防水、耐振、耐压或整车适配须以指定零件资料和项目试验单独确认。
delivery.en: Approved inputs become a controlled BOM, pin map, assembly instructions and first-article checkpoints. Check crimps, terminal retention, seal position, secondary lock, branch dimensions, continuity and mating. Ingress, vibration, dielectric or vehicle-level suitability requires exact component data and separately agreed project validation.
